description: 3D fixed top view shooter, a total of three levels, you can choose one of the levels to play, you can't save the game progress, if you die, you need to start over.

title: Space Panic Arena
description:
Fight to survive in extraterrestrial environments while scavenging weapons and ammo.
Defeat waves of enemies to earn money in order to upgrade your weapons in Horde Mode.

title: Adventures of Kok
description: You're Kok, leader of the Ghost squad. After awakening Kok notices that he found himself in an unknown universe. Escape from this place and return to your home world.

title: Lost Items
description: You wake up lost in a maze and realize there are many items on the ground. They all seem high-valuable, so you decide to pick them all. But there are also many ghosts that don't really want you to pick the items. Not that they will try to kill you, but they'll steal and move the items...

title: Delirium
description: Delirium is a psychological horror game set in a suburban house. After a mysterious explosion, reality begins to unravel.

title: Huedango
description: This game is intended to be simple and easy to play to pass time. Inspired by 90s hand-held consoles. In this game you select an egg to hatch and take care of one of the many creatures. If you keep your creature alive long enough it will eventually mature.

title: WireNet
description: Minimalistic scroll-shooter with green-on-black pseudo-vector display. Rush through the isometric madness of WireNet to the NeuroCore!

title: Epic Cards Battle 2-Dragons Rising (TCG)
description: 3D PVP Free Fantasy Strategy TCG Online Game！Experience the legendary battles. Hundreds of cards. 3 Card types: Creature, Spell, Trigger. Campaign and Arena and Ladder.

title: Sobreviva
description: Awaken the COMPETITOR inside you! Destroy enemies with your strategy and skills on an island that floats in the sky.

title: Bloodlines of Prima
description:
Infinite power.
Unlimited wealth.
Eternal life.

Those brave enough to conquer the untamed primordial lands will be richly rewarded should they unearth what legend claims is hidden there. Tread carefully. If you die, you lose everything.

title: CanBoom VR
description:
'CanBoom VR' is the VR version of Android game 'CanBoom'.
The target of User is to clear 100 stages and you meet more
difficult obstacles and cans if you break stages.

title: Robot Heroes
description: Control the mysterious robot army to resist falling giant aliens. The combat system more like Nintendo's famous game "Pikmin" (designed by Shigeru Miyamoto), but with pixel graphics and simple control. If you didn't play "Pikmin" before, you can try our game, a 2d pixel "Pikmin" game.

title: Dungeons & Treasure VR
description:
Dungeons & Treasure is a roguelike multiplayer created with voxel art for virtual reality.
The game is an endless fast-paced action adventure. You progress through different environments with unique enemies, bosses and challanges like traps and minor puzzles.
Download the demo below.

title: Fatty Rabbit Hole
description: Fatty Rabbit Hole is an action arcade game where your goal is to eat as much junk food as you can, while falling down an endless hole. In your way lies gross healthy foods, obstacles, and an assortment of dastardly foes. Inspired by the improv comedy of the podcast Matt & Mattingly's Ice Cream Social.

title: Gnomes Garden: New Home
description: Gnomes Garden: New home — a continuation of the exciting fantasy strategy game about the world of gnomes. Obtain the Crystal of Eternal Light and return prosperity!

title: Freedom Defender
description: Freedom Defender is a satirical tower defense game set in a fictional country obsessed in keeping it's borders free from foreigners.

title: Edges
description: Edges is a small fast paced game where you control a snake-like player on its path. The catch is in traps that are standing on its way - you have to move left or right to avoid them. Your player moves on its own and all you have to do is control its jumps left or right.

title: SchoolWar - VR AnimeGirl
description:
Become an adorable schoolgirl in VR world.
 Customize yourself and prepare for battle! SchoolWar is a 1v1 shooting game that you throw a chalk eraser. Just grab an eraser and throw to opponent girl! Meet the cute toon-shaded girls which you have not seen ever in VR.

title: Homelesshood
description: You are homeless person at post apocalyptic Earth. Use cans, bottles and other weapons to kill homeless people who are stopping you during your travel to the last bridge on Earth. But be careful, you are not the only one who can throw!

title: Angry Gnome
description:
It isn't good to steal other's thing, especially if it that belongs to the gnome, because he has the axe and nasty character. He will bring deserved punishment to impudent thieves. 
You should help Sumotryas to return the chest full of magic coins stolen from him .

title: Lightwire
description: In Lightwire, you play as a young weapons engineer trying to save your dying home planet. You must harvest enough energy and resources from various energy nodes throughout the galaxy in order to satisfy the growing demand back home. Use your math skills to strategically fire lasers in order to get the highest score.

title: Arenus
description: Arenus combines exciting arena based combat with unique characters and management mechanics. As the Warden you will chose your gladiator and set off on a path to make her champion of the Arena.

title: SpaceCraft
description: The Universe is yours. SpaceCraft is an online space exploration and building game. Explore a vast galaxy of solar systems and planets, mine and craft resources, design and build ships, automate planetary bases and interplanetary logistics, trade and cooperate.

title: Silicon Zeroes
description: Build hardware. Solve puzzles. From the creator of Manufactoria, a new open-ended puzzle game set in Silicon Valley's first startup.

title: The Nightmare from Beyond
description: The Nightmare from Beyond is a cosmic-horror third person platformer inspired by the works of H. P. Lovecraft. You take on the role of Sanja, a young woman from the D'nyg race, as she explores a mysterious land in search for her sister, Dajana.

title: Power War: The First Men
description: Power War - The First Men is a First Person Multiplayer game.

title: Orn: The Tiny Forest Sprite
description: Beautiful levels and a lovable hero take the spotlight in Orn: The Tiny Forest Sprite, a puzzling platform adventure game. You play as Orn, a tiny forest sprite created by the ancients, the last hope to combat the darkness. Will the powers you gained along your journey help you defeat the darkness?

title: Turret Sector
description: Turret Sector is an action packed 3D tower defence game and top down shooter.

title: Polygoneer
description: Polygoneer is an arcade reflex based game. You should defend yourself from polygonal enemies that come from all sides, hitting them with the right color shot, one miss and its the end.

title: Fall Fear Fly Redemption
description: Adventure is a journey with an uncertain outcome. Fall Fear Fly Redemption provides an immersive experience that keeps the player guessing. Take a leap of faith and see where the journey will take you. Be part of a Social Entrepreneur and Community Revitalization effort.

title: FreeFly Burning
description: Fly the spherical drones, pass the levels in different modes, set new records!

title: Strangers of the Power
description: Strangers of The Power is a dungeon crawler RPG where the player can select between three different characters. Each character also has one unique follower.

title: JetFly
description: JetFly is a 2D Arcade, Side Scrolling, Indie Game. Based on 2D Graphics

title: Operation Sheep Defense
description: Operation Sheep Defense is a fast paced tower defense game. Featuring dynamic levels and intelligent enemy behavior. Shape the enemy path or defend maze-like levels. Levels are short and intense.

title: Logos
description: Here is a planet whose Supreme Lord, Main Logos can be You! The fate of mankind and fauna who inhabit the planet and that of the wandering extraterrestrials may be in your hands. Teach them or destroy them, set the army of the undead on them, or blow them up with an alien invasion. It’s up to you what future brings for your mortal proteges.

title: Crimson Tide: Operation Online
description: «Crimson Tide : Operation Online» — is a multiplayer online game that combines the features of FPS, combat simulator and RPG.

title: Phantom Warfare
description: Phantom Warfare is a team-based FPS game, designed exclusively for VR. Choose one of three advanced weapons and make the best of your weapons to gain the victory。

title: Disassembled
description:
Enter a new breed of wave based shooter. 
Disassembled - The futuristic game show where you will 
start from the bottom and work your way up the celebrity ranks by surviving an onslaught of carnage against wacky bots. 
 
Travel from sector to sector earning in game currency from every show to improve your arsenal and defenses, from minions that fight for you to full automated turrets.

title: All Evil Night
description:
This is a story about a cop who witnessed strange events near the city Evilween. 
You will meet monsters from your nightmares.

title: Zombitatos: Ultimate Game of the Year Edition
description: Zombitatos: Ultimate Game Of The Year Edition is the remaster of the classic point and click game ''Zombitatos: the end of the Pc master race'' In this game you play has Jon and Jack in their crazy adventur to save the world from the zombies! Are you ready to experience Zombitatos for a second time?

title: MarZ: Tactical Base Defense
description: MarZ Rising is a tactical base defense game, which lets you discover a completely new gameplay experience of the tower defense genre! Build, manage and defend your martian base. Guide your crew safely through the thrilling campaign and solve the mystery of the undead.

title: Metronix Lab
description: Metronix is a 2D Platform / Puzzle game, set in a laboratory specializing in creating artificial intelligence, where the player must prevent a hacker invasion by solving puzzles using the scenario in their favor.

title: Exon: The Impossible Challenge
description: A fast paced stealth game for those who have enough courage to face the impossible.

title: Apocalypse Knights 2.0
description: “Apocalypse Knights” is an Action Game. It’s up to you, the heroic knight, to take back lands tainted with darkness. You shall save the world with blessed weapons, armors, ultimate skills, and holy horses. Come, your destiny awaits!

title: Karradash: The Lost Dungeons
description:
Karradash: The Lost Dungeons is an endless action-roguelike.

The game's character creation has 16 classes with over 70 skills to pick from once unlocked through village upgrades using gold collected across attempts. There are different dungeon settings with 100 randomly generated floors to fight through to challenge a final boss, a run can continue after this fight which increases the difficulty and starts a new dungeon from the first floor. Random events can happen between floors with a chance to meet different characters or merchants.

title: Solmec: Among Stars
description: Solmec: Among Stars is a resource management game which allows you to play as the Ankazil, giant space roaming beasts. Infected by the Rot, you must travel across the different solar systems to find your way home. However, the Rot has spread across the galaxy making once peaceful environment’s infested with hostile enemies.

title: Fur Up
description: Fur Up is a simple and sweet arcade score-chasing game. Constantly beat your previous score if you're playing alone, or survive the longest if you're playing against others.

title: Whait Bandana
description: Well, there is only one character in this game and that is Blu's, Yello's, Grin's and Purpul's cousin Whait. Whait is a ninja with a special training in mind - achieve perfect balance between black and white, yin and yang. This is exactly what your mission is going to be here - pass through all the stages and achieve perfect balance in each one.

title: Maze Run VR
description:
Maze Run is a rogue-like escape runner for VR.
100'000 square feet procedurally generated maze, destructible and paintable.

title: Ancient Worlds: Jaguar's Fate
description: Ancient Worlds: Jaguar's Fate is a fast paced casual indie game where you, as a warchief, will conquer South America.

title: Yello Bandana
description: Well, there is only one character in this game and that is Blu's brother Yello. Yello is a ninja with a special training in mind - achieve perfect balance between black and white, yin and yang. This is exactly what your mission is going to be here - pass through all the stages and achieve perfect balance in each one.

title: Red Number: Prologue
description: You have to survive on Mars as a simple technique of John, he will have to fight with dangerous enemies, find other survivors and learn that the accident occurred in the colony "a New Dawn".

title: Shooty Squad
description:
Shooty Squad is a fast paced, competitive multiplayer first person shooter. 
With weapons and maps focused on being as balanced and competitive as possible ! 
Also has offline Zombie mode.

title: Om6n
description: Darkness has swept over a once peaceful world and an malevolent omen has awoken. Will you brave these demonic legions - or fall victim with the rest?

title: Headliner
description: What if you controlled the News? Short media bias adventure game about controlling the news and it’s impact on your career, society, and family.

title: Throne of the Dead VR
description: You've been caught with your pants down... Literally!

title: Where the Money Is
description: 'Where the Money Is' puts you in control of a gang of notorious bank robbers as you attempt to score the biggest payout of your career. Using each member's special ability, you will make your way through 50+ puzzling levels and ensure everyone escapes unscathed.

title: Evil Labs
description: Evil Labs is a game about building and managing your own Evil Laboratory. Research and develop diseases, infect people, sell the cure and get rich!

title: ChefU
description: Built exclusively for VR, ChefU puts you in your dream kitchen where you never have to wash dishes or clean up after yourself. Hone your cooking and knife skills with over 60 items to cook and dozens of cooking tools. Leave the mess for someone else to clean up.

title: VR2Space
description: VR2Space is a made for VR experience that uses real world HD video footage to recreate the experience of flying to an altitude of 30 km above the surface of the earth on a floating platform. An immersive VR environment allows users to warp to set altitudes above the earth, and return to the ground by jumping off of the floating platform. Works with and without a VR headset (Oculus or Vive).

title: Shapes4
description: The goal is to draw each level's shape in just one move - that means that going over the same line more than once is not allowed! There are lots of different shapes that make levels in this game, some of them are easier to draw, and some of them not so much easy.

title: Kukui
description: Kukui is a first person horror game. You play as a 10-year-old named Kyle that is in a coma due to a severe injury, however, you play in his subconscious, accessing all his memories and events that happened before the accident. As the story unfolds you will find out what happened and how you ended up in this situation.

title: Brain Crush
description: Brain Crush is a mind, “strategy”, and fast thinking game in a world of 2D. Basically, the biggest goal of the game is to reach a blue portal looking a lot like the main character. The game might improve your real life reflexes and logic thinking as well. Jo tak!

title: Solitaire Mystery: Stolen Power
description: Top Rated Hidden Object and Solitaire Game Play!

title: Mad Farm
description: You and your family are in danger! All of your lovely animals turned into blood thirsty zombies! There is no time to get guns and you have to use what you have at hand. Fight for your life and destroy the source of this Madness.

title: Rollercoaster Xperience
description: Enter a new world where the music will join you in incredible fallings that will test your stomach... a new dimension of the experiences full of secrets and characters that will shoot up your adrenaline and make that you wish to enjoy this wonderful travel again and again... Be brave! Live the xperience!

title: Deadline
description: Deadline is a 2D puzzle-platformer in which the player character, a drop of ink, leaves a permanent trail that becomes solid level geometry. Levels are completed by routing a single continuous stroke to the exit, with medals awarded based on the total length of ink used. Additional mechanics include trail-free pen lift dashes, solvent pools that erase drawn ink, and an antagonist called the Red Pen that pursues or erases the player's trail. The game features a five-chapter campaign of hand-drawn levels, unlockable remix stages, and cosmetic customization. Developed by Geared Games Studio.

title: Raccoon Hero: The Marsh
description: Your goal in this game is to help the raccoon cubs escape their ball cages by matching their color with the color of the ball you throw at it. The babies are hidden among hundreds of other colorful balls. So basically, you need to destroy as much balls as necessary and achieve the certain score that is calculated for every level.

title: Raccoon Hero: Under the Sea
description: Your goal in this game is to help the raccoon cubs escape their ball cages by matching their color with the color of the ball you throw at it. The babies are hidden among hundreds of other colorful balls. So basically, you need to destroy as much balls as necessary and achieve the certain score that is calculated for every level.

title: Antaria Online
description: Antaria Online is a Cross-Platform MMORPG being developed with community feedback.

title: Slugs Destroyer
description: Slugs Destroyer is an atypical adventure platformer in the 2D world: you do not need to hurry to anywhere. Explore every cube of this world! Pass through enemies and obstacles.

title: Full-On Paintball
description: First person shooter paintball game

title: Flipper Hazard 5
description: Flipper Hazard 5 is a sequel to Flipper Hazard 4 which brings completely new stages and levels into play!

title: Life on Mars Remake
description:
Remake of the 8 bits MSX2 game of the same name, with a 16 bits look.
Genre: Metroidvania (2D Metroid/Castlevania style) with RPG elements.
Explore, investigate, find improvements for your suit, find weapons, upgrade your weapons in workshops, fight incredible mutants...

title: Sweet Berry Crush
description: Sweet Berry Crush is a puyyle casual match-three game with a goal to match the same kinds of berries to clear stages.

title: Dungeon Manager ZV: Resurrection
description: The Heroes are coming to raid your Dungeon and its up to you to make sure they find it challenging. Design your own dungeon and fill it with Monsters, Traps and Treasure!

title: The Stone
description: You will play the role of Jake, the hero of the story, falling in love with Aurora, daughter of the President. You will explore VR style designed science fiction world of Galactic Federation and the spiritual world of "Pioneer" of ancient world. You will equip with different set of weapons, using gesture recognition to turn on the shield system, releasing the "blink" skill. These skills can be used for different fierce fighting mission, challenging various brutal enemies.

title: Island Dash
description:
You are controlling the Tourist through the whole Island.
Your goal is to collect as much money as quickly as possible, so the Tourist can buy himself a Hotdog.
If you are to slow and he runs out of calories, he will die. :(

Do you think you can make it?

title: Behind the Door
description:
It's a story about a skeptical detective John who's investigating the abandoned's house massacre where group of teenagers were killed.
On early night Detective John arriving to the abandoned house to find out what has happened there but suddenly he realized that he is not alone...

title: Sinkr
description: Sinkr is a minimalist puzzle using various contraptions to sink pucks. Responsive ambient music. No holes left behind.

title: Letter-Setter
description:
Letter-Setter is a casual puzzle game with words.
Move letters and collect words for getting high score. Destroy so many letters as you can by one step for get bonuses.

title: Ungrounded: Ripple Unleashed VR
description: Unleash your inner hero in this 16 player PvP VR arena. Fly and engage in high action aerial battles with energy blasts and charge beams. Grapple across buildings facing off against giant Titans with your two swords, or play as a Titan and crush the tiny humans going after you in this. Motion sick players be warned, this is no bars held, no teleportation, no baby steps.

title: Bloody Mice
description: It is time to annihilate those damn mice! Try to get more points and defeat your friends in the ranking. Do not let those rats proliferate and rule the world!

title: Questr
description: Manage a party of personalities on epic (and goofy) quests. Swipe right on who you like. Swipe left on who you don't. Watch out for liars and be careful how you spend your gold! Of course there's plenty of exciting encounters along the way. Can you keep everyone happy while turning a nice profit?

title: Peninsular War Battles
description: Peninsular War Battles places you at the forefront of Napoleon’s campaign to conquer Portugal and Spain. Play is possible as the British, French or Spanish across 5 campaigns with a total of 40 missions.

title: Katharsis
description: Katharsis is a surreal exploration game with puzzle elements. The main character wants some milk. So go find it.

title: Navy Field
description:
Fight in World War II Era 32 vs 32 Naval Battle in Real Time!

The seas of Navy Field beckon for you to take command of your WWII era vessel and join the field of battle.
Be prepared to experience intense naval battles against large teams of real opponents from across the globe.

As a massively multiplayer online tactics simulation game, Navy Field provides an ever changing gaming landscape for you to customize and enjoy to your liking.

To help you on your quest to become the ultimate commander of the sea, over 100 unique WWII era naval vessels are at your disposal.
Work your way from humble beginnings in maneuverable yet vulnerable frigate class ships all the way to the epic BB6 class battleships.
Along the way, experience the unique capabilities and play styles of destroyers, battle cruisers, aircraft carriers, and submarines!
Each model reproduced in painstaking detail.

Choose from among the United States, United Kingdom, Japan, Germany, France, USSR and Italy to start your naval career within Navy Field.
Each nation balanced through a variety of strengths and weaknesses with additional nations soon to join.

How you choose to advance through Navy Field is up to you. Special missions are available to help players develop their skills and delve into battle immediately.
Strategic teamwork is encouraged through a robust squadron and fleet system.
New modes and features are continually being added to ensure that Navy Field remains the ultimate choice for authentic strategic naval action.

title: Kingdom City Drowning Ep1 - The Champion
description: Enter the vast chaotic depths of Kingdom City in a brand new narrative series for high-end VR headsets. Follow Brooks, James and Maika, three delinquents bound by violence, trauma and love on a journey of survival through an endless metropolis of depravity and crime.

title: Witch Thief
description: Play as the Witch Thief, dodging and weaving through terrifyingly intricate bullet storms on her journey to steal the Ancient Grimoire.

title: Space Crawl
description: Built exclusively for VR, Space Crawl launches you aboard an abandoned space station. Handle weapons with real-life movements, dodge space aliens, move in zero-gravity, and put your survival skills to the test. Truly an immersive first person zero-gravity experience.

title: Aegyptus
description:
Aegyptus is an adventure game which is a bit unique.
Explore the open world map by solving puzzles to gain access to the pyramids and escape from the desert and traps.

title: Toys Gun Fire Boom
description: A small action game 4 players, each for yourself or in cooperation, in a destructible decor.

title: Yet Another Zombie Defense HD
description:
Build your base by day. Defend it by night. Stay alive as long as you can.

Yet Another Zombie Defense HD is an unusual mix of dual-stick zombie shooter and tower defense genres. The player is free to choose from nine unique weapons and mount them onto auto turrets or set up defensive barricades to stay alive as long as he can. There are also power-ups to collect, different zombie types to shoot at and cooperative mode.

title: Town Doubt
description:
Tianmin town because of what has changed, Tianmin town villagers one after another death behind what hidden secret.
The protagonist because the country's reform into the town of Heaven, what will happen?

title: Defend the Cake
description: Defend the Cake is an a-mazing strategic and scrumptious tower defense game. Take your time planning a maze of toast walls and constructing methodically placed defenses. Then get ready to deploy your Eggbirds in real-time to power-up your defenses and fend off the invading armies of bugs.

title: Super Bunny Man
description:
A physics-based couch-coop platformer about a guy in a rabbit costume. Beat levels, time attacks, find hidden carrots, all while evading spikes, boulders, pitfalls, and other challenges.

Play campaign mode in singleplayer or co-op with a friend, or play deathmatch with up to 4 players.

title: Twin Brothers
description: It's an excellent game which is you can play it entertainingly and fight against your friends.

title: StellarHub
description: StellarHub is a starbase management game where your job is to build a safe and functional space station. Deal with the challenges of managing a station crew while taking care of everyone’s needs. Your tasks include construction, extraction of resources, defense, trade, and more.

title: Call of War
description: Take over the control of one of the mighty nations during the times of World War 2. Conquer provinces, forge alliances and build up your economy. Research top secret weapons of World War 2 and become the one true superpower!

title: Mini Hockey VR
description: Mini hockey VR is a fun game that puts you 1 v 1 with a computer goalie. you get a glove, stick, blocker, and pads to keep the puck out of your net. Try to beat him in 3 diffuculties, Easy, Pro, and All-Star.

title: The Last Sorcerer
description: You are The Last Sorcerer. Equipped with two awesomely dangerous weapons, exploding fireballs, and long-range fire arrows, you have to defend the Tree of Life from the waves of super scary monsters. You can teleport to special locations in your village to cover all attack areas.

title: Super Mr. Kake
description:
A unique cartoon-fighting video game experience visually inspired by The Ren & Stimpy Show.
Super Mr. Kake tells the story of a retired Superhero that is now dedicated to creating wedding and birthday cakes.

title: ColorCode
description: Creative games for creative minds.

title: NeoCube
description: Neocube is the puzzle game in which you try to find a way to pass a number of test chambers by using the unique features of a cube.

title: Brickochet
description: Brickochet revitalizes classic brick breaking action in this fast-paced, explosive arcade game that all can enjoy!

title: Elementals Reborn
description:
In Elementals Reborn you will explore the forgotten lands and fight their inhabitants. 
Increase your rate by fighting in different modes, alone or with allies. In Elementals Reborn, you can find entertainment of your own!

title: Great eSports Manager
description: Manage a house of eSport gamers by training the strong, and pruning the weak. Then go head to head with North Korea, the greatest gaming nation in history.

title: 0°N 0°W
description: A cross country road trip turns into a multi-dimensional walkabout after a quick stop in a mysterious town. A first person surreal adventure of visual auditory stimuli set in a fantastical world.

title: RC Plane 3
description:
Learn to fly a large selection of RC Planes in huge and beautiful scenarios rich of detail.
Grab an easy flier to enjoy a majestic sunset over the hills of Tuscany or hop in a fast stunt plane to fly through barns and high voltage pylons.
Practice landings, stunts, wind handling and cow scaring or compete on global leaderboards across the many challenging game modes.
Realistic and Arcade physics simulation available, with a ton of camera options. Detailed scenarios to explore with secrets to uncover.

title: D'lirium
description: An experimental 2D-shooter with the elements of a horror game. D'lirium brings together some mechanics back from 90s classics. Non-linear levels, search for the keys, violence and a lot of other things. Including the colourful ponies.

title: Lethal Laser
description: 《Lethal Laser》 is a directional laser based tower defense game. No bullet/arrow shooting nor warrior producing, just pure laser. Laser reflection, split, color separation, color combine, play it with strategy you never seen in TD games.

title: Les Quatre Alices
description: A short visual novel, made in RPG MAKER MV, which has the particularity of having heroines with an ASD, for Autistic Spectrum Disorder.

title: Hiking Simulator 2017
description: Experience nature like you have never seen it before as you take your hiking to the next level!

title: Legends of Iona RPG
description: Zaak is trapped ! Help him to go through a five level dungeon and to escape back to the surface. Amazing dungeon crawler RPG. Unlock the power of the Ionix crystals to become a Hero. You can turn on/off the quiz EBS system if you just want the adventure part of this game.

title: Breadwinner VR
description: Fast, frantic sorting action! Breadwinner puts you in the shoes of a QA worker at a bakery. However, Nexcor Technologies is no ordinary bakery - you'll quickly find yourself overwhelmed by an absurd quantity of bread. With five unique game modes and an additional endless mode, Breadwinner challenges your physical dexterity and mental agility.

title: Dead Maze
description: Dead Maze is a 2D MMO game set in a destroyed contemporary world, filled with zombies. Explore the world, scavenge and craft as many items as possible, to survive the hostile environment and upgrade your gear and camp as you go.

title: Rosebaker's Icy Treats
description:
Rosebaker's Icy Treats is a virtual reality game that sends you into space to sell ice cream!
You’re in charge of Rosebaker’s mobile ice cream parlor, selling their famous icy treats to travelers in transit from around the galaxy!

title: Undead Souls
description: Undead Souls is an arcade game about killing enemies trying to Beat your Score in a gun filled randomly generated levels.

title: K'nossos
description: K'nossos is a cold surreal adventure game about a man traveling the unknown reaches of the cosmos and the things he uncovers on his journey.

title: Equalizer
description: Equalizer is a musical arcade game in which you act as the main character inside a music tape recorder where you have to jump on platforms and discover new possibilities, such as music tracks and environments.

title: Bad Government
description: A politically incorrect satire text based roguelite game.

title: Tales of Legends IV: If
description:
- Overview
1000 years has passed since the Holy Crusade.
This is a story woven by the ancestors of Heroic lineage.

Protagonist "Shin" is a young lad aiming to become a Doll Master.
In order to pass his graduation examination, he must up his skills.
Chloe takes him with her to investigate some ruins and gain some
real experience but... Resett is jealous of their relationship...

In the end, can Shin actually graduate successfully?
And what secrets lye within these ancient ruins?

title: Civil War: Gettysburg
description: Civil War: Gettysburg is a strategy game taking place during the Civil War. The game features historically accurate game play and five scenarios covering the battles of Thoroughfare Gap, Furr Farm, Goose Creek, Ewell's Chapel, Marsh Cree, and Little Round Top.

title: Mayhem Above
description: Music Score Attack Game. Play YOUR music and spread it across the universe!

title: Indeep
description: Play this casual classical dungeon crawler anytime and anywhere and save your progress for later. The dungeon is waiting for you!

title: IsoBoom
description: IsoBoom is a 2D isometric puzzle game about a small robot named SE01. The protagonist gets sent to a maze of puzzles as a punishment for theft. SE01 was promised forgiveness if he manages to beat the maze and escape.

title: The Rosebud Condominium
description: Help Sarah, an aspiring architect, build a sprawling tower in this quick-paced hidden object game spanning the universe!

title: Beetle Uprising
description: Breed for stats, looks, and abilities; then use your creations to dominate the entire vacant lot in this RTS/Genetic Simulation. Use fluid "swarm" combat tactics to gain control of resources vital to your colony's expansion and secure a genetic future for your swarm.

title: Witch Hunt
description:
In a formerly peaceful village, mysterious incidents are taking place.
The climax is reached when one night five of the villagers disappear.
The mayor gives you the task of investigating what happened.

title: Renegade Grounds: Episode 1
description: First episode of a thrilling adventure! Two mercenaries, Agela and Ingus, are tasked to infiltrate the criminal underworld to retrieve a device of high value that was stolen from the council. The job gets more complex as more factions join the hunt for the item, but to Agela and Ingus, failure is not an option!

title: Radical Spectrum: Volume 2
description: Radical Spectrum Volume 2 is an arcade-style platformer, featuring constant, endless action. Doc DuBrane is gearing up once again to save Nucleusport. After a crushing defeat, the reckless alien Prince FaceBox and his minions have relocated to the in-construction Sine Wave Tower, the tallest building ever (almost) built.

title: Jarheads
description: Jarheads is a fast-paced tactical shooter with fully-destructible environments. Jarheads comprises of a 50 mission single-player (or two-player online co-op) campaign and a separate online multiplayer experience for up to 8 players with a variety of explosive game modes.

title: DepthMera
description: DepthMera is a 2D Rogue-like platform shooter where you collect symbolic pictures of self-discovery to transform your haunted home into a vibrant haven. Explore dynamic levels, battle epic bosses, and uncover a story of growth and redemption.

title: Hero of the Galactic Core
description: Explore the Galactic core with your hero in a real time "Heroes of might and magic" space style RPG game; find upgrades, artifacts, drones, turrets to build base defenses, fight enemy fleets and heroes in fleet combat until you locate the Jump Ship points to engage the enemy base with waves of drones.

title: Tiny Toyfare
description: Tiny Toyfare is a Tower Defense/FPS hybrid with a focus on strategic calm followed by twitch action. Construct powerful towers, recruit adorable squads and fight off the Dino invasion!

title: Meta Star
description: Have you ever been playing a game and wondered, "Why can't I fly!?" or "I wish I could customize my spaceship!"? Well, Meta Star is your answer!!! Race the rest of the internet to beat the game, and the winners get to tell the developers what to include in the next update!

title: Dungeon; Friends Escape!
description: Dungeons with Friends is a multiplayer exploration and survival game. Team up with friends or find the exit alone as you explore dark rooms filled with unknown traps, enemies, and curses.

title: Crafting Dead
description: Crafting Dead is a multiplayer based survival game with a voxel theme. Aim high and punch low, survive at all costs! Psst, bring a friend. They can help carry gear.

title: Hold the Line: The American Revolution
description: Hold the Line covers battles fought during the American Revolution. This game is a careful conversion of the board game of the same name developed by Worthington Publishing. Jump in and take command of the American or British forces during this pivotal moment in the history of nations!

title: The Myth Seekers: The Legacy of Vulcan
description: Discover the truth about the legacy of ancient gods!

title: Solitaire Ultra
description: The best Solitaire game on Steam! Get lost in space and time as you chill out to classic Solitaire gameplay, beautiful high-def visuals, awesome ambient soundtrack, and tons of unlockables.

title: Better Off Tread
description: Better Off Tread is a nonstop arena combat game with up to twelve players squaring off against each other using a collection of unusual – and often comical – armored vehicles.

title: F.E.X (Forced Evolution Experiment)
description: In F.E.X (Forced Evolution Experiment) you are a failed experiment in a facility where they manipulate human DNA in order to stop the aging process. You are able to grow old at will, but you can't reverse the process. Get out before your time runs out or you get caught.

title: Masked Forces 2: Mystic Demons
description: Are you ready to explore the underworld and kill hundreds of monsters and demons in the process?

title: Stick Engine
description: Stick Engine puts the tools in your hands to create insane stick shenanigans and share them with the world using the Steam Workshop.

title: Crushing Blow
description: An exciting and engrossing arcade, in which your goal is to destroy everything you see and not be overwhelmed. Crush! Saw! Throw! The game contains plethora of levels, each with its own unique goals, interesting situations and challenges of your reaction and decision making skills.

title: Children of Apollo
description:
Children of Apollo is an exciting twin-stick shooter in a short, arcade style format using a blend of classic and modern gameplay elements. 
After the Apollo missions humans send an expedition to explore Mars but things go terribly wrong.

title: Aces High III
description: Aces High III offers world class modeling of World War II planes, vehicles, and boats in a combat setting with hundreds of other players pitting their skills in any given online arena.

title: Psychic Isolation
description: Psychic Isolation is an episodic narrative horror game revolving around the horrible fates of the ones that are now trying to kill you.

title: Plumber 3D
description:
You have to test your ability to assemble the water system in the right order and find the code to move to new challenges. 
Moving from level to level you have to fix more and more complicated and intricate schemes.

title: VR Battleship Yamato
description:
Full Scale Restoration of the Japanese battleship “Yamato” in VR.

Battleship Yamato was constructed during the World War Ⅱ in 1941, and it was the biggest battleship ever built. Unfortunately, Yamato didn’t last through the war, and it sank to the bottom of the sea.
Now, battleship Yamato is completely restored in full scale in VR. It is based on the blueprints and the recollections of the actual crew who are still alive.
In this app, you can actually get on Yamato and walk across the deck, climb up the bridge, and go inside the ship.
See the Yamato crew taking command. View the explosions of the gun fire from a close distance.

title: Magician's Gambit
description: Chess! Magic! VR! Play this age-old Game of Kings against the best strategic mind in the Kingdom - a master tactician and chess paragon unlike any other. Word is he has never been defeated... Will you rise to the challenge?

title: Damascus Gear: Operation Tokyo HD
description: Mecha Hack'n'Slash ”Damascus Gear: Operation Tokyo HD Edition", now appearing in full HD graphics! Build your very own weapon system "Gear", and reclaim our lost world! The battle for humanity to retake Tokyo begins now!

title: Alicia Quatermain: Secrets of the Lost Treasures
description: Alicia Quatermain sets out on a long and dangerous journey to find out why her father had disappeared under mysterious circumstances

title: Bacon May Die
description: Fun beat'em up game with brave little pig fighting hordes of weird enemies

title: Costumenaut
description: Costumenaut is a top-down shoot 'em up game with a roguelike elements. You play as a poor nerd who has been abducted by alien spaceship and wandering the universe, whose costumes are his only weapon.

title: Mirror
description: In this world, you will play different roles and have many stories with female characters in several different world. There are elf thief who thinks herself a noble, dragon maid who can never make up her mind, queen who loves females, forest huntress that enjoys the company of her toy-boys...

title: Regenisis Arcade
description: Regenisis Arcade is a VR physics-based arcade shooter in futuristic setting. Waking up from a long period of hibernation, you'll discover a world ruled by different robot factions. Each one will try to use you for their own goals, ranging from protecting you as probably the last human on earth.

title: Fashioning Little Miss Lonesome
description: When two handsome young men spot the perfect girl to be their first model and help make a name for themselves, they're determined to go for broke and make her shine—but first they'll have to get her out of her house! Can these two really give such an anti-social recluse the makeover she needs to be a star? Or will she be the one to change them in this off-beat romantic comedy?

title: Skyfront VR
description: Skyfront VR is a team-based multiplayer FPS where the best warriors team up in zero-gravity battle arenas to determine the Ultimate Champion.

title: Dragon's Dungeon: Awakening
description: Dragon's Dungeon is a hardcore adventure for roguelikes connoisseurs and RPG fans. Fight with the monsters, explore the labyrinths in search of new equipment and priceless treasures, improve your skills using a non-standard system of character development and gain victory over the dungeon lord.

title: Reflector: Bug Hunt
description: Reflector is a top-down shooter style game where the player's only weapon is their ability to catch and reflect the enemy barrage.

title: Ka Mate
description: An adventurous TV presenter goes to New Zealand. He want to find this place to investigate the story of Maori & Haka Dance. The adventurous who encounters with unexpected events will have to struggle for life against wildlife.

title: Depth of Extinction
description: THE SEAS HAVE RISEN A cataclysmic event has forced humanity to build undersea environments to survive. Now 500 years have passed and we are in decline. Pirates, raiders, androids and worse things scour what is left of these habitats looking to survive. Find cover and attack enemies but be careful because every move is critical if you want to keep your team alive.

title: Blue Angels Aerobatic Flight Simulator
description:
Become part of the BLUE ANGELS TEAM; try the aerobatic simulator licensed by the U.S. Navy!

Experience flight at 400 mph just 18 inches from your partner’s wing and face the challenge of official maneuvers aboard F/A-18 fighter jets and a C-130 transport aircraft. An assisted driving system allows everyone to learn even the most extreme stunts and thanks to the three play modes, anyone can experience the thrill of a real aerobatic pilot according to their abilities. Do you think you are really an expert? Compete with the simulation mode and push your reflexes to the maximum!

OFFICIAL and SPECIAL MANEUVERS
Discover all the secrets of aerobatics with 3D briefing, take complete control and activate the aircraft with the right timing on the rudder, landing gear and smoke deployment! Take off, fly and run all opening maneuvers with the C-130 “Fat Albert”, either "PARADE PASS" or "ASSAULT LANDING," with no limits, and you just have to give it your best. Now you can sit in the cockpit as a soloist and perform an "AILERON ROLL" to familiarize yourself with your own F/A-18 to then use all your adrenaline in increasingly challenging and complex maneuvers up to formation flying: the "DIAMOND ROLL," "DELTA BREAK-OUT," and "FLEUR DE LIS" are just a few examples of all the possible shapes that you will be called upon to perform by covering all roles of the true Blue Angels pilots.

AIRSHOW
Plan your exhibition by composing real aerobatics with faithfully reproduced official scenarios: NAF El Centro, NAS Key West, Reno, Elmendorf AFB and Baltimore. Your ultimate goal is to complete all airshows! You can do this by executing the real maneuvers in sequence or randomly. You have the freedom of choice. For every maneuver, you decide what role to play: the #1 FLIGHT LEADER, one of the wings, the #2 RIGHT WING and #3 LEFT WING, the #4 SLOT or one of the soloists, the #5 LEAD and #6 OPPOSING SOLO.

ADDITIVE MODE
Create aerobatic figures with additive mode! Freely position the planes in the scenario you've chosen and decide whether to make them take off. You can start with a standard flight or high altitude and then take control of each aircraft in sequence. Aim nose up, make a loop, light the smoke, fly as you like, and when you're satisfied, the session for the first plane ends and the second aircraft takes off. Choose to fly in free formation or DIAMOND, DELTA, ECHELON, and LINE ABREAST and make spectacular combinations that you can relive with the use of multi-camera replays.

EXPERIENCE AND SCORES
Our trajectory detection system will tell you how accurate you are and the more precise you will be at all stages of the maneuver, the higher your score. Complete the figures to your best ability, exercise, win all medals and gain experience to rise to this level. This will give the you best scores and you will reach the top of the leaderboard!

MAIN FEATURES:
- F/A-18 fighter jets and C-130 “Fat Albert” transport aircraft
- Innovative formation flying and assisted guidance system
- All official Blue Angels maneuvers, playable in all roles
- All configurations: takeoff, diamond, delta, echelon, line abreast and soloist

- Use Airshow Mode to complete a real exhibition with a custom sequence of maneuvers
- Additive Mode to create your aerobatic figure
- Special missions: free flight, exploratory, pursuit and C-130 JATO

- High definition scenarios with Rortos REAL 3D TECHNOLOGY

- 3D Briefing display for easy understanding of the maneuver
- Innovative help system with three difficulty levels to suit both beginners and more experienced pilots
- Accurate trajectory measurement system for evaluation of the score
- Best world performance rankings

- 3D virtual cockpit
- Multi-camera replay system with dynamic views
- 3D exploratory area to deepen knowledge of the aircraft

title: The Legacy: Forgotten Gates
description: "The Legacy: Forgotten Gates" is a hidden-object adventure game packed with mini-games and puzzles, telling a story of a journey to another world, where danger and unexpected turns of events await around every corner!

title: Endless Dream
description: This game is a suspense micro fear love to AVG game, a total of three men can fall in love; Different male characters will bring you unique love experience.

title: Anomie
description: Anomie is set in a fictional world that resembles our modern day. The protagonist, Quentin, finds himself experiencing a chain of events that leads him to what can only be described as a new life. A new place with new rules—a new life, a new future. Will the public authority's desperate efforts bear fruit?

title: Trivia Vault: Science & History Trivia 2
description: Welcome to the Trivia Vault contestant! Play as a contestant in a gameshow called Trivia Vault: Science & History 2 and bring your thinking hat. Answer all new science and history category trivia questions as quickly as you can, the faster you answer the higher the cash value.

title: Paper Knights
description: Paper Knights is an artistic stylized RTS (Real Time Strategy) game which puts the player in charge of controlling tiny paper armies and deciding about their next moves in battles and sieges.

title: Padria Online
description:
Experience true open-world freedom in Padria Online - Hardcore PVP massively multiplayer online role-playing game.
Choose from many different classes, decide whether to focus on PvP or PvE, both sharing the same world, no matter what in this full PVP game you will be entertained!
no matter your poison whether you combat, crafting, magic, trading, there is something for everyone.
Countless skills, resources and tools to master to old and control the lands.

title: Vacant
description:
Film a ghost-hunting show.

A narrative pixel-art horror game.

title: Jobous the alien R
description:
Jobous and his wife is living the dream in outer space. When suddenly ( dramatic music ) his wife want some new shoes. Oh no she is going to use all their space money (jup she is kinda a money spender). Jobous 
Immediately panics. What should he do? Jobous takes his ship and travel after her.

title: Fjong
description:
Help Fjong and his friends to reach the sky.. by Eating Candy! 
Fjong is a relaxing, colorful and non-violent game that suits every kind of player and skill level.

title: RetroGunX
description: Miss playing those 8-bit, button-bashing, classic arcade-style cabinet and cartridge games from the 70s and 80s? Ever wanted to experience the intense action from the point of view of the hero within the game? Now you can, in VIRTUAL REALITY.Take down wave after wave of unique enemies, each with their own style of movement and attack, and reminiscent of the art style (graphics capability) of the day. Collect power-ups, unlock new weapons and defeat massive bosses in this classic VR Shooter.

title: Continuous Girl
description:
Players in the cave to kill the monster to stop forward, every save a girls, the player's bloodthirsty sword can strengthen +1.
Players need to save their girls to strengthen their own while moving forward.

title: Madu Maths
description: Based on a school curriculum, Madu Maths tests primary school kids in addition and subtraction as they help bees collect honey for their hive. A solo developer effort, Madu Maths boasts challenging gameplay coupled with an original score and organic graphics to make for a fulfilling experience.

title: Unlikely Stickman
description: You - Stickman, who needs to survive in a harsh and dying world. Avoid blows, hide from shots and attacks. Defeat all enemies and save the world.

title: The Mice of Riddle Place: The Incident of Izzy Ramirez
description: Help Izzy solve the mystery of what is causing her asthma! In this game, the player will embark on an exciting journey to identify the causes of Izzy's asthma using Science, Technology, Engineering and Math in the exciting world of Riddle Place.

title: Hexlide
description: A minimalist, relaxing puzzle game with beautiful music.

title: Purgation
description:
You awake gradually. You are in a dark cell. You are drifting in and out of consciousness between bouts of violent hallucinations.

You are physically weak and have no memory of who you are or why you are here.

You are alone and you are scared, very scared.

The voices in your head tell you that you should be.

title: Pizza Connection 3: Pizza Creator
description:
The Pizza Creator from Pizza Connection 3 is now playable for a limited time and is even garnished with a contest to determine the best pizzaiolo of all!
Create your best pizzas, upload your creations online to Facebook, get the most Likes for them and pull in great prizes including Pizza Connection 3 Steam Keys for release!

title: Purpul Bandana
description: Well, there is only one character in this game and that is Blu's, Yello's and Grin's sister Purpul. Purpul is a ninja with a special training in mind - achieve perfect balance between black and white, yin and yang. This is exactly what your mission is going to be here - pass through all the stages and achieve perfect balance in each one.

title: Raccoon Hero: The Frost
description: Your goal in this game is to help the raccoon cubs escape their ball cages by matching their color with the color of the ball you throw at it. The babies are hidden among hundreds of other colorful balls. So basically, you need to destroy as much balls as necessary and achieve the certain score that is calculated for every level.

title: Match and Crash
description: Match and Crash is a little 3-way-match puyyle arcade casual game that will test your fruit matching skill and ask you to clear all its stages.

title: The Far Frontier
description: The Far Frontier is a combination of two popular game genres: match 3 and strategy. In game you must fight using one match 3 area for two players. Use tactic and strategic solutions to win.

title: Gappo's Legacy VR
description: Dodge, cover yourself, hit, shoot, catch and throw the deadly waves of pirate drones as you join the Makina Resistance Army in their historical battle for freedom. But to make it into the MRA, you must keep creative and polish your skills to enter the top rankings.

title: Insidia
description: INSIDIA is a tactical game of turn based duels. Carefully move your team of powerful champions and weave their attack together to claim victory in the field of battle. Conquer your foe and claim the spoils of the post-apocalyptic world.

title: SlingSkull Zombies: Graveyard Shift
description: SlingSkull Zombies: Graveyard Shift is an action cartoonish game where your goal is to hit and destroy every zombie in every level by hitting them with a skull projectile.

title: Hard Era: The Fantasy Defence
description: Hard Era: The Fantasy Defence - mind-boggling game with many possibilities. See yourself as supreme governor: control combats on battlefield, slowly diving into charming atmosphere of fantasy world.

title: Stellatum
description: Setup your battle ship with guns, install faster engine, reactor that is more powerful and throw a barrage of rockets on hordes of enemy ships, burning everything in your path.

title: Seconds to Square
description: Seconds to Square is a momentum-based action-platformer where players draw boxes to manipulate time.

title: Geometry World
description: Put the box on the correct position and get 100% of the game.

title: Spaceship Trucker
description: Spaceship Trucker is a 2D shooter. You are a spaceship trucker travelling down the dangerous star route. The Flees will try to block your way through space and pirates want to steal your precious cargo. Watch out for meteors as well. In each level you'll have to prove yourself worthy of being a spaceship trucker by fighting off dangerous boss enemies.

title: Space Waver
description:
Space Waver is an action-adventure space game, with a strong bind to comics.
Become a space mercenary and experience his life through multiple contracts.

title: The Istrys
description:
Cubistry and its sibling 3D match 2 puzzle games dubbed the Istrys by fans are now in one place as "The Istrys".

Manipulate a cube of cubes in 3 dimensions and find identical cubes to make them disappear! Cubistry adds a new "spin" to the old classic of matching puzzle games. Whether you play by yourself or with your friends, Cubistry is guaranteed to deliver hours of relaxing fun!

title: Wrongworld
description: Wrongworld is a silly yet unforgiving survival game set on a low poly world filled with freakish inhabitants.

title: Robothorium
description: Robothorium is a futuristic turn-based RPG combining rogue like gameplay and turn-based combat. Lead a robotic uprising by playing the AI, choose your allies by taking decisions and manage your team of robots to free them from the Human domination.

title: Pro Gamer Manager 2
description: Pro Gamer Manager 2 is an e-sport simulator game. Create, manage and compete with your own team of Pro Gamers. Conquer all obstacles and become the number one team in the world!

title: Goodnight
description: A short kinetic novel about a nameless boy who expresses his thoughts under the gentle shine of the night sky.

title: Wild Buster
description: Wild Buster is a gritty science fiction hack'n'slash MMORPG with a MOBA influence - Collect and level more than a dozen unique heroes to master PvE (including co-op and raids) and PvP content!

title: Cats Tanks
description: Tanks game - which will make you remember the past and help test new feelings. To all fans of classical tanks - dedicated. Protect your headquarters from a variety of enemies.

title: Mind Trap
description: Mind Trap is a Twilight Zone "Inspired" 4 Episode psychological thriller series. Where the player must explore and follow the clues as the stories unfolds around them.

title: Chop and Drop VR
description: Take on the job of a line worker removing troublesome trees! Get out your chainsaw and use your control levers to maneuver the utility bucket in all directions, but watch your head!

title: Black Death: Divarication
description: Black Death: Divarication is 2d metroidvania with a storyline and RPG elements that will put you in a whole new and a detailed science fiction universe of alternative future. In the game you will have to act as an officer of the Mortus's order who has to keep a watch in one of the colonized worlds.

title: Who's your Santa !?
description:
The game is a puzzle. Definitely will break you a couple of convolutions.
The game is a test for a sick fantasy. If you pass it from the first time - think, are you all right?
The game, after which you will need 5 years of enhanced psychotherapy. By the way, we, too.

title: Legion Tale
description: Take part in the stories set in a continent of Agia where the terrible conflict between two races transpires. Join Alan, a young man from Skarleta who lead a small legion of warriors to take over the reign of Dark Lord. Find the true raison d’etre behind the conquest of the Agia in this Tactical RPG.

title: Mashinky
description: Mashinky is a transport strategy game about trains. The goal is to create your own transport empire on a procedurally generated map. It’s a unique blend of realistic graphics combined with an isometric construction mode and board game-like rules.

title: UnderHuman
description: UnderHuman is a physics based Roguelite Platformer RPG. Act as human boy Carl to fight through Capitol island, mutate your body with animal power and utilize 300+ props and abilities. Find the reason why Beast Plague is rampant among the land.

title: Keyboard Sports: Saving Qwerty
description: You play as the young apprentice to Master QWERTY who takes you on a wild adventure across oceans, through temples and into dreams in the search for your inner key using the entire keyboard as your controller.

title: Dice Tower Defense
description: Don't let the enemy destroy your kingdom! You must defend your positions in a merciless battle against an endless stream of invaders. Think carefully about your defense and survive as long as possible!

title: Bees Knees
description: Take control of the state of the art, Robotically Assisted Pneumatic Horticultural All Environment Levitator (Often simply called R.A.P.H.A.E.L), the latest weapon deployed by the honey industry in the war on bugs.

title: Triple Otakus Puzzle
description: Japanese etchi style puzzle game which contain 3 different puzzle game. Game contains nudity images

title: Pixel Traffic: Risky Bridge
description: Drive your car and get to the end of the bridge or you'll fall into the abyss! This requires good agility and a quick reaction!

title: Forest Guardian
description: What would you do if you met a fox girl in a forest? After collapsing in a forest while trying to make it to the local port before winter sets in, a lone merchant, Anna, wakes up in a pristine shrine. It doesn't appear as though anybody else is there, with the exception of the caretaker, a kitsune who introduces herself as Mayu. Being the guardian of the forest, Mayu laments the fact that, with the exception of Anna, she has not had any visitors to her shrine in many, many years. Yet duty calls, and she is a very diligent fox girl. As thanks for saving her, Anna wants to help Mayu bring visitors back to her shrine, but what she learns in the meantime may end up making her change her mind. Confronted with Mayu's past, what will Anna do?

title: Zambi 2 Kil
description: Zambi 2 Kil is a quality game about, you guessed it! Killing zombies, and only that. So yeah, that's it 'cuz everyone just loves zombies. Get it and go kill all the zombies. You just walk around and fight zombies.

title: Loot'N Shoot
description:
In a world driven by automation, you jump into one of many warehouse robots that experience a malfunction and start fighting each other with everything they can find. 
The objective of this fast-paced game is to defeat all enemies in multiple themed warehouses before they can defeat you.

title: Z Runaway
description: A simple and fun arcade. Get on the mad speed in the van, get the money on the road! And try not to break up and lose everything you've been able to gain from your long life at the warm, sunny shore of the sea.

title: Dinosaur Island
description: Players need to survive on an island filled with dinosaurs and other dangerous creatures.

title: Press and Jump
description:
Click and jump! What is difficult in this. 
 
Hurricane runner from "Limed". 
Your task is to jump as far as possible. 
Time is getting faster, will you have time to jump as much as possible? 
If you jump crookedly, you will fall down, so you need to be careful.

title: Black Day
description:
Black Day is a singleplayer shooter game based on infiltration.

Black Day allow you to personalize the game experience by setting different variable such as equipment, number and types of enemies… therefore you can design a funny and easy game or set up a hardcore infiltration mission where even farting may result in your death…

title: Sole
description: Explore the remnants of great cities and uncover the history of an ancient civilization on your journey through the dark world of Sole.

title: Awakening: The Goblin Kingdom - Collector's Edition
description: After overcoming the Dreamless Castle and Moonfell Wood, you have come to the rugged, mountainous snow-peaked Goblin Kingdom!

title: European Mystery: The Face of Envy - Collector's Edition
description:
This is a special Collector's Edition includes:

- A bonus mystery that takes you to the city of Dresden!
- Wallpapers, concept art, and videos
- Wonderful music tracks from the game
- An available Strategy Guide

title: Clad in Iron: Gulf of Mexico 1864
description: Manage your fleet and army, hunt the enemy's fleet, hide your weak squadrons in protected ports until reinforcements arrive, blockade enemy trade routes, amphibious assaults, struggle for dominance over the seas in turned-based strategic mode. The real time tactical battle mode allows you to set up battles and squadron groups with their formations and management using realistic ship models and characteristics as well as advanced ballistics and weapon models. ATTENTION! In the game there is no interactive training, only a textual manual.

title: FPV Drone Simulator
description: This FPV Drone Simulator is especially designed for practicing your drone flying skills! Fly in different environments. Choose 'free ride' or 'fantasy forest'.

title: Triton Wing
description: Triton Wing is a top-down, open-world space shooter full of fast action.

title: Kaet Must Die!
description: You are Kaetheran, an extremely powerful psionicist with a flair for cyberpunk style. You have awoken in a dank-AF sewer without your mind powers. You must figure out how to escape the sewer without losing your life while the blood witch Annalinnia tries to make you insane.

title: HumanKind: The Awakening
description: Enter the battle between four factions fighting to control the future of humanity.

title: Neon Coliseum
description: Neon Сoliseum is a fun and simple but at the same time highly addictive 2d action game in neon style. Face off against colorful neon villians as you attemt to collect as many score as possible. Your weapons are lasers, and this is a unique and interesting combat system that you will definitely like.

title: Middle Earth Hero
description: Are you ready to start travelling and save the kingdom with a little hero? Middle Ages Hero is a classically styled 2D action adventure about the lost world where dark powers hold the world and the kingdom.

title: Gender Bender
description:
Hate it when video games force you to identify as gender binary? Want some more options? Want the gender universe brought to life? Watch the genders fresh off of tumblr battle it out in the newest action-fighter of the season.

*Not all genders implemented. (yet)

title: Damn
description:
DAMN the machines! Nobody know who put a virus in the Lab.34 LAN, but now the smart robots produced inside the lab have started an uprising against their creators!
Scientists and technicians are trapped inside and surely face certain detah, can you help them?

title: Pulses - Crystal Journeys
description: Match 3 is so 2016. Pulses - Crystal Journeys is a lascivious love letter to Tetris and Lumines, but with bombs. Crush your last candy, and come explore the wonderful, fast-paced world of Match-X

title: Relic Keepers
description: Relic Keepers is an action game set in a fantasy setting. Helped by the village guards, keep the artefact inside the village walls and outlast a legion of evil creatures.

title: Launch Party
description: You and your teammates are armed only with a manual to instruct you in your task of launching rockets. Work together to enter codes, push buttons, flick switches and turn knobs in order to win.

title: Christmastry
description: Manipulate a cube of cubes in 3 dimensions and find identical cubes to make them disappear! Christmastry adds a new holiday "spin" to the old classic of matching puzzle games. Whether you play by yourself or with your friends, Christmastry is guaranteed to deliver hours of relaxing holiday fun!

title: BackSlash
description: BackSlash is a spell casting brawler featuring style-mixing, arena destruction, and accelerating duels. Combine two styles to plunge into a dance of destruction through flying blades, bone breaking punches and devastating spells.

title: The Mexican Dream
description: Protect America from losing it's resources as Americans flee from the country and Mexicans enter, shoot them down by creating weaponized wall the likes that no one as ever seen!

title: PooPee Wars
description: PooPee Wars — a game about the holy war of purity and order against dirt and a disgusting smell.

title: Pocket Universe : Create Your Community
description: Prepare for a brand new adventure in Pocket Universe, a game which combines adored mechanics from strategy and RPG genres. Our vision is an experience which does not solely revolve around the player, but also the world itself which is inhabited by artificially intelligent agents. Pocket Universe tells the story of a human-created planet, following events which threatened the survival of the human race.

title: Never Not Shooting
description: The sun is under attack. It's up to you to defend it, unfortunately you will fail. So you'll get your friends to help you and you can all fail together. Figure out how to fail slower in Never Not Shooting, while getting a better score than your friends.

title: Tick Tick Pass
description: The ultimate trivia game, Tick Tick Pass is a list-filling game suitable for single players or parties alike, with hundreds of hours of content!

title: Bomber Crew
description:
Players will find themselves deep behind enemy lines, attempting to destroy their most coveted assets, while dealing with various hazards such as flak guns, enemy radar, weather and dreaded Ace Pilots.

Recruiting, training and guiding the right crew, and keeping them alive, is vital in turning the tides of war and achieving success on your bombing campaign.

title: Champions of Odin
description:
Champions of Odin is a first-person, action role-playing game that combines the fast pace and intensity of a first-person shooter with RPG elements.
The story and theme of the game draw from Norse Mythology. Play as a magical frost giant who is forced to make a deal with Odin, the god of all gods!

title: Firefighting Simulator
description: Experience firsthand the daily challenges of an American first responder in Firefighting Simulator. Play out the gripping rescue missions of an US-American fire department unit - either alone as a single-player or together with others in the multiplayer mode.

title: Destination Dungeon: Crypts of Warthallow
description: Destination Dungeon is a new casual style of dungeon crawling. Instead of roaming around a huge dungeon looking for opportunity the opportunities come to you. Random events take place including traps, locked doors, enemy encounters, merchants, and more.

title: Indygo
description: Indygo is a narrative game with elements of point'n'click set in one room only - painting workshop. It tells the story of a painter who suffers from depression. Solve puzzles and make decisions that affect how the game ends. Indygo attempts to show how people with depression can feel.

title: Lost with Dinosaurs
description: Collect power up that help you reach all placed in order to collect mushrooms. Avoid dinosaurs that will steal them from you

title: Glitch Simulator 2018
description: You are living in a simulation, and the simulation is glitching. Explore the virtual world, find glitches, fight zombies and break through the illusion. Bugs, bugs are everywhere...

title: 2D Neon Cube
description: 2D Neon Cube - it's beautiful and not difficult to pass the game. Exciting obstacles and graphical effects. Move the main character to the portal and try not to die!

title: Billiards
description: Realistic and very easy to play billiards simulation with five different games: 9-Ball, 8-Ball, Straight, 3-Balls and Snooker

title: Royal Agents: Sweet Zombie
description: Royal Agents: Sweet Zombie is a turn-based squad game with unlikely agents trying to stop evil in time for tea. You control a team of three agents of the crown with different skills and backgrounds, tasked with the assignment to investigate and stop any evil-doings in a graveyard.

title: Immersive Poetry
description: Enjoy an interesting twist on classic poetry by solving puzzles and following the story of the Wilkins Family. From the islands of Finland to the snowy mountains of Russia, you’ll explore and experience beautiful maps based on real world locations in this new puzzle game. Can YOU complete them all?

title: Frog X Bird
description: Daring amphibian warriors take flight to prove themselves as top frog of the arena.

title: VirtuGO
description: VirtuGO is a classic puzzle game. Colored tiles come at you nonstop, and you must put them on your carrying platform and arrange them as best you can on a 5x5 grid.

title: Freshly fried shrimps seemed hot additionally named noth
description: A laughable 2D-RPG made with RPG Maker MV

title: Pegasus Door
description: As professor Finn, you must eliminate all the waves of ennemies send to get you back to the organisation you created but left in a rush. Protect your armory from damages with the weapons at your disposal, buy new ones and upgrade them with the money you collect from your frags.

title: Landon
description: Everyone lives in an utopia, because science makes huge leaps in every area. But Landon, he's not happy. He's not getting the enjoyment he wants, so he tries to get some.

title: Space Asteroid Shooter
description: Get ready to blast your way into the endless space and survive as long as you can against dangerous asteroids and deadly enemies.

title: Labyrinthian
description: A simple game with no puzzles, no traps, and no enemies. Just you and a maze. Can you get to the end of it, or will you forever be trapped in the labyrinth?

title: Mr. Jumpington 2
description: This is a game where you control Mr. Jumpington while jumping through different caves and your goal in every level is to collect all the coins.

title: Mr. Jumpington
description: Mr. Jumpington is a jumping hero and an adventurer exploring caves and looking for golden coins.

title: Slash/Dots.
description:
Let's cut wood and hit balls against each other !
Simple refreshed puzzle game "Slash/Dots" !

title: Protagon
description: Protagon is a hybrid casual game that blends concepts from mini-golf and pinball with an intuitive VR interface. Just pull the handle on the ball, aim and release to launch it into the zero-gravity course!

title: Cute Monsters Battle Arena
description: Massively addictive turn based strategy RPG with intense action & puzzles.

title: Thanksgivingistry
description: Manipulate a cube of cubes in 3 dimensions and find identical cubes to make them disappear! Thanksgivingistry adds a new holiday "spin" to the old classic of matching puzzle games. Whether you play by yourself or with your friends, Thanksgivingistry is guaranteed to deliver hours of relaxing holiday fun!

title: Point Connect 3
description: Point Connect 3 is an arcade puzzle game with points, dots and their connectors. It may not be as easy as it sounds - some levels are bigger than other ones and the trick is to calculate the line in such way that it crosses each platform point.

title: Point Connect 2
description: Point Connect 2 is an arcade puzzle game with points, dots and their connectors. This game's goal is to connect all the dots of equal color while using up all given platforms.

title: The Surprising Adventures of Munchausen
description: Enter a beautiful world of adventure and intrigue. With the light and prosperity of his Kingdom gone, the King has no choice but to marry his daughter to a mysterious stranger in order to save his realm.

title: Broke Protocol
description: Become the Most Successful (or Most Wanted) man in the city. Broke Protocol is like a low-poly GTA Online with a strong focus on roleplaying features. You define your own goals and identity in a persistent, interactive, and reactive online sandbox. Currently in Early Access.

title: Surface: Game of Gods - Collector's Edition
description: Save your friends and escape from a deadly game!

title: Otherworld: Shades of Fall - Collector's Edition
description: Explore a world of magic to stop an ancient evil!

title: Labyrinths of the World: Forbidden Muse - Collector's Edition
description: Can you help the City of Artists find their lost inspiration?

title: Horde Attack
description: Horde attack is a demolition derby in middle ages! Send swarms of riders from city to city to conquer the huge world in this fast-paced multiplayer strategy game!

title: SlingSkull Zombies: The Dawn
description: SlingSkull Zombies: The Dawn is an action cartoonish game where your goal is to hit and destroy every zombie in every level by hitting them with a skull projectile.

title: Alimardan Meets Merlin
description: Merlin, the wizard? The Wizard of Oz? Or the wicked Morgana, daughter of Uther, the Enchanter? None! Seeing some aliens on his way to the moon, Ali Mardan Khan decides to jump out of the spaceship. Little did he know that his calculations were wrong and so he finds himself in the Middle Ages. There, he should pose as “the Wizard Baby of Oz” and solve the mystery of missing kids, find Merlin and King Arthur, save the wicked Morgana, and even find Excalibur!!

title: Alimardan's Mischief
description: “Ali Mardan’s Mischief’s” is a cheerful musical game directed at children that narrates the naughty behavior of a little boy who has driven everyone nuts with his shenanigans! No matter how easy or appealing naughtiness, messing up the kitchen, putting banana peels on the floor, and poking chickens with sticks might seem, it is not so easy to make up for them. If you love laughter, joy, lots of cool naughtiness, and of course a happy ending, you shouldn’t miss “Ali Mardan Khan’s Naughtiness”.

title: Containment Corps
description: The laser bow wielding security force has been called in. Fulfill your obligation to the Containment Corporation, keep the energy bases operational. Containment Corps mixes first person action with co-operative strategy and tower defense elements.

title: Treasure at the Top
description: Slice monsters. Release energy balls. Uncover mysteries.

title: Adoption
description: PC+VR horror game, where you have to help a little girl to find her mother and figure out what is really happening in your house and who your neighbors are.

title: The IOTA Project
description: The IOTA Project is a VR game where you are thrown into the cockpit of a giant mech. Pilot IOTA as you destroy the enemies who have taken over the city using your two giant robot fists and an array of powerful weapons.

title: MeiMeiDance
description: MeiMeiDance is a sports game based on SteamVR.Zero distance contact dancer. View dancing from multiple perspectives.Learn dancing with her.If you like to watch MMD, then you must not miss this game.

title: Halloweenistry
description: Manipulate a cube of cubes in 3 dimensions and find identical cubes to make them disappear! Halloweenistry adds a new spooky "spin" to the old classic of matching puzzle games. Whether you play by yourself or with your friends, Halloweenistry is guaranteed to deliver hours of relaxing spooky fun!

title: Space Fighter
description: "Space Fighter" is a vertical scrolling flight shooting game. The player controls the protagonist fighter to fight the enemy in the universe.

title: Skeleton Sprint
description: Use interesting puzzle mechanics like the burrow power-up, on challenging puzzles that increase in difficulty and complexity as you play through the game.

title: Ravager
description: Ravager is a 2D Open World Platformer with 12 unique characters to ravage your way across the land. Each character has different upgrade abilities to fight against the army of Crows and Trolls, who are trying to unleash the Nidhoggr into the world.

title: Infection Rate
description: 3rd person Co-op Zombie Survival with multiplayer

title: Door Kickers: Action Squad
description: Rescue hostages, disarm bombs and save the day in this old school, side scroller action with retro graphics and retro sensibilities. Coop MP Included.

title: Rules of Destruction
description: "Rules of Destruction" is a story-driven role-playing game which sends you into the era of the two worlds Astrila and Meldoria. Forge your destiny and define the future of this fantasy universe, full of magic, mythological creatures and more

title: Code: 9
description: Deduce evidence using your own words in crime investigations against the fascist regime of Aeterna. Prove yourself in real debates where every word matters. Johann Richter discovers Klara, a mysterious speaking artificial intelligence. Where does she come from? What is her mission?

title: Shapes5
