description: Puppy Luv Adventures is a PC-exclusive entry in the Puppy Luv franchise.

title: Game Room
description: Game Room is a virtual game room where you can play checkers, darts, air hockey, billiards, pinball, snake, and arkanoid. Explore the space from the first person, enjoy classic games, and beat your records

title: The Last Chapter of Man
description: A pandemic simulator on a virtual globe, modelled with real-world population density, where the player must control the spread to keep the "fire" alive.

title: Bad Smell
description: A top-down shooter for PC and Mac.

title: Wallaby!! Usagi no Kuni no Kangaroo Race
description: In this game the player bets on races. The twist is, the racers are wallabies. They also have rabbits in their pouches. The game takes place in a world largely inhabited by the said rabbits, but there are other animals, such as koalas who serve as bookmakers. The game also features managerial elements, as the players must manage their racers. The player can choose to play as one of four rabbits and name them. The racing itself is non-interactive, the only option being to change focus from one wallaby to another. The player can watch a race whether they've made a bet or not.

title: Peacekeeper
description: An open world MMORPG, designed around 4 floating regions. Developed by Celant Interactive. Currently in closed alpha

title: Blade Kitten: Dirty Angels
description: Blade Kitten: Dirty Angels is a run-and-gun spinoff of the Blade Kitten video game/comic series.

title: ReVeN
description: ReVeN is a side-scrolling sci-fi action-adventure inspired by the Metroid series.

title: Aima Online
description: Embark on an epic adventure in Aima, a 3D side-scrolling MMORPG. Choose your character from over five unique classes, including the Swordsman, Runeblader, and Assassin. While each class is gender-specific, you have the freedom to customize your character's colors and appearance extensively. Unlock new moves, skills, and abilities to perform longer combos and unleash devastating attacks. Explore diverse dungeons in teams, collaborating to layer skills and conquer monstrous bosses. Join a guild, test your mettle in PvP battles, and unlock Guardian transformations for your character.

title: Kilgazar
description:
Kilgazar's army has captured your village! It's time to take matters into your own hands! Battle your way through hordes of enemies. Learn and use powerful magic spells. Infiltrate the fortress to pass through the gateway to the dark underworld. Can you defeat the demon lord, Kilgazar, and free the land from his grasp?

Kilgazar is a turn-based strategy roguelike that pits you against hordes of enemies. Designed to play like a board game, it features a streamlined interface that makes the game deceptively simple to play while presenting a challenge to players. Blending strategy, planning, and a bit of luck, it takes more than sheer aggression to make it to the end and defeat the demon lord Kilgazar.

title: Astrobase Command
description: A sandbox space station-building game.

title: Glacier Blast
description: Puzzle game for Windows 8

title: Celtic Heroes
description: Are you looking for that classic MMORPG vibe? Whether you're a minmaxer strategizing every detail for maximum efficiency, a savvy fashion collector in search of the most stunning outfits, or even someone who enjoys the journey of casual leveling, Celtic Heroes opens its gates to you!

title: Intruder
description: A home invasion thriller

title: Master of Epic
description: An MMORPG released only in Japan.

title: Mermaid Swamp
description: This is a remake of the original game that adds new art, upgraded graphics, Japanese voice acting, reworked puzzles, and various quality of life and gameplay improvements.

title: Paranoiac
description: Paranoiac is a freeware horror adventure game by Uri made in WOLF RPG Editor.

title: Sky is Arrows
description:
Welcome to Sky Is Arrows, a captivating and intricate fantasy world filled with heroes, epic battles, treacherous exploration, deadly traps, and the ever-looming threat of permanent death. Prepare yourself for a thrilling journey where you must marshal your armies, safeguard your castle against relentless attackers, and embark on a quest to empower your hero to unimaginable heights. Will you have what it takes to vanquish all who stand in your path?

Immerse yourself in a realm brimming with dark secrets and enigmatic locales. Each Act of the game is designed to offer a unique and unpredictable experience, ensuring that no playthrough is ever the same. Venture forth, for beyond the shadows lie ancient graveyards, mysterious shrines, and an array of enticing item and gold chests awaiting your discovery.

As you progress, your hero will grow in strength and prowess. Strategically allocate skill points to enhance your hero’s attributes, shaping them into a formidable warrior capable of decimating hordes of foes. Alternatively, focus on honing a particular spell to unearth its true potential, unleashing devastating powers that will leave your enemies in awe.

Beware, for the world of Sky Is Arrows is relentless. The challenge steadily intensifies over time, and as you push forward, the game grows increasingly difficult. Strengthen your hero to face the ultimate showdown against the formidable final boss or risk succumbing to the overwhelming onslaught of enemy heroes and their augmented armies.

title: Sangoku Hime: Ransei, Tenka Sanbun no Kei
Sengoku Hime 4: Souhai Hyakkei, Hana Mamoru Chikai
description: SystemSoft Alpha once again returns to the little known era of Japanese history where the battlefields were dominated by cute girls with brightly colored hair.

title: Rapid Assault
description: Rapid Assault is a first person vehicular combat game by Synthetic Dimensions.

title: Space Live: Advent of the Net Idols
description: Humanity abandoned reality and decided to reside in Net Space. Net Space is divided into a number of factions, and every four years, they hold a concert for control of all the Spaces. With such high stakes at play, the heated battle between Space Idols shall commence!

title: USA Racer
description:
A clandestine group has been organizing illegal street races in the USA for more than 50 years. What started as a fun event has grown into an annual contest for cash and glory. Only six are given a chance to prove their worth.

US Racer contains 11 tracks in different locations across the USA. Players can race in cities such as Los Angeles, New York or Washington DC or can take part in a race through the Grand Canyon or Yellowstone. Next to Time Trial and Single Race, the Tournament is the main event. It has been split up in three sections: Park Trial, City Trial and US Race. After completing a section, the next one is opened up.

The tracks contain obstacles and jumps. Enemies will try to push other cars off the road, and the police also make an appearance. Scattered around the tracks are power-ups that repair the car, provide boost or cash. The money can be used to upgrade the car, repair it or buy boost prior to the race. After completing an entire tournament with a certain car, an alternate vehicle becomes available for that character.

In the Windows version two-player duels are available over LAN or TCP/IP. Players can either go head-to-head or play a game of Cop vs. Racer.

title: Astérix & Obelix Take on Caesar
description: Astérix & Obelix Take on Caesar is an action video game based on the film of the same name.

title: Life Is Strange 2
description: Life Is Strange 2 is an episodic adventure game played from a third-person perspective. Players control Sean Diaz, a teenager on the run with his younger brother Daniel after a tragic incident forces them to flee their home in Seattle. The game uses a road trip structure inspired by films like Into the Wild and Stand By Me, with each episode set in a new location along the US West Coast. Sean must make choices that affect both the story's branching paths and Daniel's developing morality and behavior. The game explores themes of family, brotherhood, and contemporary social issues through its narrative-driven gameplay.

title: Murder in a Wheel
description: A Locked Room Mystery Story: Roderick, Lady Blackwin's beloved Hamster, was murdered. It is up to you to solve the crime and find the killer.

title: Friday: Death to Arthur Yahtzee
description:
This is graphical point-and-click adventure with simple original engine. The game, like most 3rd Person adventure games, consists of action buttons which you use to interact with your surrounding. Simple as it is, it has your standard Look, Use, Talk, Inventory features.

You are Arthur Yahtzee, a dole-bludger living in Los Angeles, who is credited with one major event - when the local Federal Research Institute started spawning hideous mutants, he single-handedly stopped them. Now, another branch of FRI in Chicago are spawning more mutants, and this time they're after YOU...

title: The Tuttles: Madcap Misadventures
description: The Tuttles Madcap Misadventures is a hilarious arcade adventure game about a thoroughly modern family trying to bond on a road trip to the Alamo. Beautifully detailed art and wonderfully silly situations bring this familiar story to the Interactive age.

title: Forever Growing Garden
description: Some hardware companies often published their own games in order to bundle them with their hardware (when they couldn't get enough big-name games to sign with them). This is one such product. Forever growing garden's gameplay consists of selecting seeds, etc. and taking care of them in order to later sell your crops on the market and flowershop (were you can also make flower-arrangements, etc.) the game is aimed at kids, so everything from the interface to the objectives are kept very simple and straight-forward. Also the game is filled with hot-spots that start animations or sound effects.

title: Risk: The Game of Global Domination
description: Lead your troops to victory in this modern version of the classic RISK game.

title: Maverick Bird
description: A Flappy Bird inspired game by Terry Cavanagh.

title: Jarokn Cricket 2
description: Jarokn Cricket 2 is the PC-based sequel to the Android cricket game Jarokn Cricket, both created by Jarokn Games.

title: The Stadium Project
description: The Stadium Project is a simplistic stadium building game.

title: Of the Red, the Light, and the Ayakashi Tsuzuri
description: A modern Japanese-style fantasy story involving Yue, a young boy born and raised at a shrine, and his friendship with the "Ayakashi" spirits. HaccaWorks* presents a mysterious, spiritual adventure game.

title: Napoleon 1813
description: A combination turn based strategy game with real time battles depicting Napoleon's campaign.

title: Man in a Maze
description: Unity video game from SmallGreenHill for PC, iOS and Mac.

title: FX Eleven
description: Top Eleven is a football manager simulation for the iPhone.

title: Romans From Mars
description: Tower defense.

title: Skydive!
description: Skydive at exotic locations and compete in challenges, like diving through rings.

title: Farm Town
description: A new game from CIE studios. It will be online for PC and XBox Live.

title: Microsoft Golf 1999 Edition
description:
A golf simulation game featuring 7 courses and 18 golf clubs. Players can customize their golfer and choose different swing and click methods.
The multiplayer had support for Microsoft's Internet Gaming Zone as well.

title: Daemon Vector
description: This action RPG features gothic-styled slashing combat as a sinister strain of the Black Plague has brought to life Medieval Europe's decaying dead. The story traces back to the 14th century when Marco Polo traveled to Europe from the Far East. A seal from ancient China was broken, awakening the monster within, which brought one of the darkest periods of the human history when Black Death covered Europe with horror. A terrible disaster without cause unveils the 3D action adventure of Daemon Vector. Choose from one of the many playable characters to battle against the the daemons that have escaped from the seal. There are more than 20 stages in 6 areas.

title: Dragoon: The Battles of Frederick the Great
description: An isometeric strategy wargame focusing on Fredrick the Great's campaign during the Seven Year War in the 18th century.

title: Arcanists
description: Customise your own unique Arcanist and engage in magical duels against thousands of other players. Tailor your spellbook to your own playing style from a vast selection of spells. Summon minions to do your bidding and ride atop powerful familiars.

title: Microsoft Baseball 3D 1998 Edition
description: An arcade style baseball game featuring robust graphics for the time

title: Sierra Pro Pilot 98: The Complete Flight Simulator
description: This is the first edition in the Pro Pilot civilian flight simulation series. The scenery is North America and Europe, and both VFR/IFR can be used with AI Air traffic controllers. The included aircraft are: Cessna Skyhawk 172P, 172R, CitationJet 525, Beechcraft Bonanza V35, Baron B58, and Super King Air B200.

title: Spanking Runners
description: Arcade combat racer developed by K-D Lab (now KD Vision) for the PC. Notably, it features a tactical, turn-based mode for "people who do not have good reflexes."

title: SpeedBoat Attack
description: SpeedBoat Attack is the second game that criterion studios made. You're racing against AI boats and racing against the time.

title: The Untouchable
description: Combat-style fighting game developed by Creative Edge and published by Tiburon Interactive Publishing.

title: Man of War
description: Man of War recreates wood ship battles during the American Revolution to the Napoleonic Wars.

title: Silent Heroes: Elite Troups of WWII
description: Silent Heroes: Elite Troops of WWII is a stand-alone game based on Soldiers: Heroes of World War II engine and more orientated on Direct Control than on group control like Faces of War does. Player commands a group of 6 soviet saboteurs who must complete extremely hard missions at the rear of the German army. The game features 10 saboteurs mission assembled into one story-driven campaign with player changing the course of war by destroying enemy radar installations, kidnapping enemy officers and hunting down legendary German Tigers. The game is fully orientated on single player campaign and doesn't feature any multiplayer modes.

title: Quest fo Karma
description: Quest fo Karma is an edducational game for PC.

title: Flyboys Squadron
description: Flyboys Squadron is a WWI action flight simulator. It presents a single player campaign and an MMO module, which requires a monthly fee.

title: Gunhouse
description: Players protect their house by any means necessary, as relentless hordes of alien invaders seek to devour the innocent little orphans inside in this take on the tower defense genre.

title: The Rapture is Here and You will be Forcibly Removed from Your Home
description: The Rapture Is Here And You Will Be Forcibly Removed From Your Home is a game created by Connor Sherlock. Each game gives around 20 minutes to look around and experience the rapture of earth. Inspired by H. P. Lovecraft.

title: ABC Monday Night Football '98
description: ABC Sports MNF 98 is the sophomore effort by ABC Sports and OT Sports.

title: Tony La Russa Baseball 4
description: The final entry in Stormfront Studios' series of baseball simulation games.

title: Vietcong: Red Dawn
description: Second expansion game to the original Vietcong.

title: Dinothawr
description: In this block-pushing puzzle game, players control a dinosaur whose goal is to rescue other dinosaurs who have been trapped in ice.

title: British Open Championship Golf
description: Rex Bradford, the man who came up with the power swing bar, returns for the first time in British Open Championship Golf with exclusive rights to the British Open course and tournament.

title: Star Stealing Prince
description: Star Stealing Prince is a freeware fantasy RPG created with RPG Maker VX by Ronove (or known as Black Birds of Rye on the official site).

title: Battle Bears -1
description: Game prequel to Battle Bears: Zombies.

title: Q!Zone
description:
Q!Zone is an authorized collection of maps for Quake by WizardWorks. It was released in 1996. It would later be bundled with both the original Quake and the Malice total conversion in the form of the Resurrection Pack for Quake compilation, distributed by GT Interactive in 1998.

The new campaign is simply a collection of 26 new single-player levels sprawled over three new episodes, plus a series of deathmatch/capture the flag maps.

title: War of Omens
description: War of Omens is a card game combining deck-builder and CCG mechanics, featuring fast, strategic play and three different playable factions.

title: SoulTrap
description: SoulTrap is a 3D platform game that takes place inside the mind of the main character of the game: Malcolm West. The fears and anxieties of Malcolm West are represented by strange often moving platform structures high in the sky. The player has to jump from platform to platform, shooting phobias taking the form of enemies and outwitting obstacles that he comes across. The game comes with 11 levels with each their own graphical theme. The player can find various weapons such as a magical axe, a .45 automatic and a grenade launcher. There are also power-ups that allow the player to replenish health and ammunition. The game allows the use of both first person and third person camera angles.

title: Huygen's Disclosure
description: An action adventure game that takes you to an alien world of mystery and hidden dangers.

title: Lenna's Inception
description:
Explore a dangerous island filled with dungeons, and defeat the eight archangels to bring order to a glitched-out kingdom in this top-down Zelda-like action-adventure game. Playable in 8-bit and 32-bit pixel art styles! 
 
Features 
- Team up with a friend. Make peace with Shadow Lenna to enjoy the game in local co-op multiplayer! 
- Play again (and again). With two graphical styles, multiple endings, multiple boss forms, and procedural generation, you won’t see everything in a single playthrough! 
- Challenge yourself. Speed through the daily challenge dungeon with no sword, with only three hearts, or without taking a single hit. Show off a GIF of your playthrough on the connected leaderboard afterwards! 
- Recruit companions. Will you choose Henrietta, the free-range chicken with a vendetta, or perhaps Gourdon, the sentient pumpkin? (4 to discover)

title: Hoyle Blackjack
description: A Sierra made blackjack game & craps PC game

title: Mind Grind
description: A puzzle/quiz style game intended to challenge players' reflexes as well as their minds.

title: Wizardry Gold
description: An enhanced version of Wizardry VII with updated graphics, voice acting, and a new interface.

title: Fantasy Realm Online
description: A sandbox MMORPG for Windows and Linux, set in the world of Moon Haven.

title: Tracer
description:
A neon, heart pounding, endless arcade racer!

Race down the gauntlet, faster and faster! How far, and how fast, can you go before you crash?

title: Babysitter Bloodbath
description:
"They locked him up and threw away the key!"

For 22 years Neokalus Burr has stared at an empty wall in the bowels of Monroe State Mental Hospital. But tonight he's escaped to continue his blood soaked murder rampage! It's also your first night babysitting

title: STCC 2: The Game
description: DLC 'Sequel' to STCC - The Game, this is an updated add-on to Race 07.

title: Guy vs. The Wicked and Nefarious Land
description: Guy vs The Wicked and Nefarious Land is a fast-paced dungeon crawler where you must guide Guy through 5 dungeons filled with evil creatures, traps, and pop culture references.

title: Disney City Girl
description: With suitcase in hand, it's time to leave your small-town life behind and head to the big city to make your dreams come true! Do you have what it takes to skyrocket to stardom? In the spirit of Sorority Life, players will engage in a stylish and aspirational virtual world, working their way through careers paths, apartment upgrades, daily catwalks, and fashion galore. From a grungy studio to a Park Avenue penthouse, from overworked intern to successful CEO, from country bumpkin to glamour girl, City Girl will keep players coming back again and again!

title: Teleportower Plus
description: Teleportower is a platformer / puzzle game. In each stage, the protagonist can teleport between each "tower" or screen in order to progress, with the aim of getting the gold crystal. 100 levels in total, along with a level editor and many custom stages (some of which come with the download). It is free, developed by "kaho", and can be found here: /~ss1/top.htm

title: Trainz: Settle & Carlisle
description: Standalone add-on for Trainz

title: Reksio i Wehikuł Czasu
description: The fourth part of Rex's Adventures. In this episode we travel through time and space.

title: Battle Bears Gold
description: Previously known as Battle Bears Royale, compete with your friends across vibrant sci-fi maps across multiple game modes. Choose from 11 unique classes, with thousands of loadout combinations to master.

title: Infected: The Twin Vaccine
description: A hidden object game based around a zombie story.

title: Tsuyokiss 3gakki
description: A further retelling of Tsuyokiss and Tsuyokiss 2gakki, takes place a few months after Celeb has transferred to Leo's class (but before the game enters any routes).

title: Tsuyokiss 2gakki
description: A retelling of Tsuyokiss which takes place a few months after Otome has started living together with Leo (before the game enters any routes) and introduces the transfer student, Celeb, who joined Leo's class.

title: Yoostar
description: Yoostar is a "film karaoke" game that lets players act out scenes from their favorite movies.

title: The Smiling, Proud Wanderer 2
description: Based on Louis Cha's novel, The Smiling, Proud Wanderer, this PC game is a continuation of the novel's storyline.

title: Ima Sugu Onii-chan ni Imouto da tte Iitai!
description: Ima Sugu Onii-chan ni Imouto da tte Iitai! is a Japanese visual novel developed by fairys, taking place before the events of Love, Elections, & Chocolate! and revolves around the protagonist Rikuto Mitani, whose father remarried a woman who already has a daughter.

title: Lovely Quest
description: Visual novel about the one man Lovely Smile Committee, and its search to find examples of pure love.

title: Rally Poland
description: Polish Rally is the first native arcade racing game. In the game we have a 4 car models and over 170 km of nicely done tracks.

title: Phone Story
description: Phone Story is a game for smartphone devices that attempts to provoke a critical reflection on its own technological platform. Under the shiny surface of our electronic gadgets, behind its polished interface, hides the product of a troubling supply chain that stretches across the globe. Phone Story represents this process with four educational games that make the player symbolically complicit in coltan extraction in Congo, outsourced labor in China, e-waste in Pakistan and gadget consumerism in the West.

title: Samantha Swift and the Mystery From Atlantis
Microsoft Bingo
description: Microsoft Bingo is a free-to-play, microtransaction- and ad-supported bingo game that has players level up and unlock new areas as they play shared online games of bingo.

title: Age of Storm: Kingdom Under Fire Online
description: Age of Storm: Kingdom Under Fire Online is an MOBA title set in the Kingdom Under Fire universe.

title: Bubsy 3D: Bubsy Visits the James Turrell Retrospective
description: A web-based 3D experience and homage to both art and Bubsy.

title: Airport Firefighter Simulator
description: A simulation game where fires must be put out at the airport.

title: Proving Ground 2014
description: A driving simulator with multiple vehicles and tracks, and real vehicle dynamics and physics e.g. ABS, traction control, stability control, etc.

title: Stellavanity: Prelude to the Destined Calamity
description: A STG from TRIS-GRAM, Stellavanity has players fight through seven increasingly difficult stages of bullet hell.

title: Santa Tracker
description: Track Santa's flight and play games in your browser and on Android.

title: Sanae Challenge!
description: A platform game, you run around the map while fighting and sealing Kedamas and the locations where they spawn.

title: Bistro Boulevard
description: A restaurant simulator.

title: Cinema Tycoon 2: Movie Mania
description: Cinema Tycoon 2: Movie Mania is a cinema simulator.

title: Slingray
description: Multiplayer team-based competitive space hockey inspired by games like Uniball and Subspace

title: Illusion: Ghost Killer
description: Set up six cameras in strategic positions to capture the elusive Jeff the Killer on film.

title: Irem Arcade Hits
description: 18 classic Irem arcade games for PC and Mac.

title: Rofaxan 2089 AD
description: Rofaxan 2089 AD is a space shooter for Xbox 360 and PC

title: Streemerz
description: Streemerz is an 8-bit retro platformer by Arthur Lee for his Action 52 Owns project. First created as a freeware PC game, it was "demade" for the Nintendo Entertainment System.

title: HeroWarz
description:
HeroWarz is the Ultimate action RPG where you select and cultivate unique heroes to build your own personal assault force. Get ready for the most addicting, fast-paced, action-packed online gaming experience!

The Korean servers were shutdown in October 2017.
The game was released briefly in North America through KOG Games before being shutdown in Match 2017.
The game had releases planned in Japan through Sega and in China through NetEase but both versions were shutdown before a public release.

In 2019, NetEase working with A.Storm announced a remake titled NightMare Breaker, 超激斗梦境, in China using the same characters with better graphics but slower gameplay.
In 2022, the remake was announced with a 2023 release date in Korea through Nexon under the title Night Walker.

title: Fjords
description: Fjords is a pizza-delivery adventure game set in a world made of science.

title: Fish Face
description: Search for a new face in a unnervingly peaceful fishing experience.

title: Action Fist
description: Action Fist is a side-scrolling game created in the style of mid-90s platform shooters. It was mostly inspired by Gunstar Heroes.

title: 0Space
description: Inspired by “Ender's Game” by Orson Scott Card, 0Space is a small 2-4 player zero gravity death-match game.

title: Project Ion
description:
Project Ion is an MMOFPS/TPS/RPG that is in development since late 2011.
The project is under constant development but has a playable version up all the time.

title: Initial D: Second Stage Typing Game
description: Initial D: Second Stage Typing Game is typing tutorial game for Windows and Macintosh, based on the Initial D driving anime.

title: Tome: Immortal Arena
description: Tome: Immortal Arena is a brawler MOBA built for non-stop action.

title: J.B. Harold Series #2: Manhattan Requiem - Angels Flying in the Dark
description:
The second game in the J.B. Harold series.

24 year old pianist Sarah Shields was found dead after falling from the 25th floor of her apartment window. The cause of death was a fractured skull from the horrific impact. With no evidence of foul play, an act of suicide was the best explanation - but J.B. Harold thinks otherwise. Having recieved a letter from Sarah beforehand, the famous detective heads towards New York City to find the truth.

title: SeeNa
description: First-person action game, published by SystemSoft for Japanese computers in 1986. Its polygonal 3D graphics engine was a technical milestone, rendering 3D environments at a fast pace and (compared to the tile-based, right-angle movement of earlier first-person games) allowed the player to move with full 360-degree movement.

title: Nicole
description: Nicole is a dating sim that revolves around your day-to-day life as a college student. You can take up part-time jobs to earn money, explore various locations, do recreational and extra-curricular activities, and meet intriguing characters like Darren, Kurt, Jeff and Ted. You might even get to date the culprit!

title: Big Buck Hunter Pro
description: Big Buck Hunter PRO is a new species of hunting game that delivers a hot new quarry of no-limit fun to players everywhere. The premise is simple; There are 4 areas with 5 rounds in each one. Each round has 3 bucks to take down with your shotgun, but watch out for those doe's, other wise the round is over

title: Cosmic Soldier 2: Psychic War
description: Action RPG sequel to Cosmic Soldier, released for Japanese computers in 1987 and for North American PC in 1989.

title: Dark Blood
description: Dark Blood is side-scrolling action game.

title: Akane Maniax: Nagareboshi Densetsu Gouda
description: It's love at first sight as brash transfer student Jouji Gouda sets out to win the heart of Akane Suzumiya in this comedic spin-off from Kimi ga Nozomu Eien.

title: Strike Fighters 2
description: Combat flight sim focusing on the early jet age, when aviation technology was still primitive but advancing rapidly, this game, along with its many standalone expansions (that can be combined into one game), encompasses the range of air combat from the mid-1950s to the late 1970s (and beyond with mods).

title: Cyphers
description: Cyphers is a Korean, third-person MOBA style Action Game where two teams try to take down a series of barricades and towers to destroy the enemy's main building and claim victory. The game has a strong emphasis on melee weapons and stylish attacks. Players may choose from a variety of 35 characters. It also has a unique progression system where the player's level depends on the number of upgrades they have.

title: Sqrxz III
description: Sqrxz must rescue his girlfriend from the forces of evil in this third outing from Retroguru.

title: Oretachi ni Tsubasa wa Nai - Under the Innocent Sky
description:
This might just be a "what if" but,

A certain day, Gretagard's pure white sky was overrun by winged ones.

Now, the sky extends just about anywhere and everywhere, right?

So no matter how far you run, you can't escape those white wings of theirs.

And that's why the people without wings went looking for a sky of their own.

Their prayers were listened, and they are now listening to "Jingle Bells" in a calm country---

This might just be a "what if" but,
What we will tell you about now, is such a fairy-tale.

title: MicroMan's Crazy Computers
description:
Retro arcade action game featuring unique levels to explore, puzzles to solve and bosses to battle! Special powerups lets you upgrade your weapons systems to battle the robotic enemies! Go for all the silver discs in four exciting levels: Electron Alley, Futile Resistor, Decompression Sector and Superconductor Challenge.

• Retro arcade action fun with puzzles, boss battles and powerups!
• Four progressively challenging levels!
• Unique puzzles, boss battles and special powerups!
• Tutorial level for new players! High scores for advanced players!

title: The Chronicles of Shakespeare: Romeo & Juliet
description: A hidden object game set to Shakespeare's tale of Romeo & Juliet.

title: Maluch Racer
description: A 2003 PC racing game from Poland about a polish car Maluch.

title: Champions of Chaos II: Ambassadors of the Arena
description: Turn-based arena RPG, developed by Epic Llama Games.

title: Arkadianax
description: Classic shmup set in space, full of nostalgic retro references.

title: Dualsus
description: Endless runner in space, developed by Revolution System Games.

title: Homesteader
description: Homesteader is an engaging tile-matching game that challenges players to construct a thriving homestead by gathering essential resources. In this game, players strategically match three or more adjacent tiles on an 8x8 grid. What sets Homesteader apart from typical matching games is its unique feature of tile movement in all eight directions, including diagonal swaps. This allows for even more strategic gameplay and opens up exciting possibilities for players to maximize their progress.

title: Crazy Power Disc Perfect
description: An updated version of Crazy Power Disk, an unofficial remake of the Neo Geo classic Flying Power Disc (aka Windjammers).

title: KarBoom
description: KarBoom is a combat racing game by JibbSmart.

title: Palette
description: Palette is a Japanese language freeware adventure game that was made with RPG Maker 95 by Nishida Yoshitaka. The game was highly acclaimed in the Fourth ASCII Entertainment Software Contest, awarded a Grand Prix of 10,000,000 yen, which resulted in remaking the game for PlayStation by Enterbrain. That version, entitled Forget me not -Palette-, saw the release on April 26, 2001 exclusively in Japan.

title: Music Master Chopin
description: Music Master Chopin is a rhythm/music game similar to Guitar Hero and Rock Band, only centered around the music of Frédéric Chopin and his contemporaries.

title: The Fall of Nemesis: Clash of the Kaijujin
description: The Fall of Nemesis: Clash of the Kaijujin is the second release in the Colossal Kaiju Combat! series.

title: Special Force
description: A 2003 first-person shooter produced by the Central Internet Bureau of Hezbollah, a Lebanese Islamist militant group. The game recreates battles from the South Lebanon conflict between Hezbollah and Israel, with the player assuming the role of a Hezbollah fighter tasked with defeating Israeli soldiers.

title: Pirate Hunter
description: Pirate Hunter is a classic representative of the First Person Shooter (FPS) genre, using an original graphics engine DIOsoft Engine. The game was inspired by Far Cry.

title: Treachery in Beatdown City
description: Treachery in Beatdown City is a comedic action thriller where players fight dozens of ridiculous enemies with a unique battle system combining the best parts of beat 'em ups, fighting games, turn based tactics and rpgs!

title: Murnatan
description: Join Humans or Aliens in the fight for survival. Build your own, masterfully thought-out base, destroy the enemy spawns or base in organized attacks, hunt down your enemies and emerge victorious!

title: Rooster
description: A heartfelt, story-rich casual puzzle adventure celebrating the best of ancient Chinese culture. Explore an exquisitely hand-drawn world with delightful surprises, from cooking, finding hidden objects, paper crafting, and more. Guide Rooster in an emotionally rewarding tale about family and love.

title: Pirate Code
description: Pirate Code is a role playing strategy game by Circuit Hive.

title: XenoMiner
description: An indie voxel-building game from Gristmill Studios.

title: Confederate Express
description: An isometric tactical RPG for the PC, in which the player's team must navigate a randomly-generated map full of zombies, killer robots, and hostile humans while delivering various packages. It was funded through Kickstarter in November 2013.

title: Saihate no Ima
description: This game tells the story of seven long-time friends. How they grew closer or further apart as they got older. The story is presented using a blog-like interface.

title: Heva Clonia Online
description: Heva Clonia Online is a free-to-play, fantasy MMORPG for PC.

title: Pia Carrot he Youkoso!! 2
description:
Pia Carrot e Yōkoso!! 2 is a dating simulation game and a follow-up to the first game. Set four years later, the Pia Carrot restaurant has proved successful, and a second location has now opened. High school senior Kōji Maeda needs a part-time job over the simmer, and winds up working at the restaurant and living in its dormitory alongside numerous cute ladies.

Gameplay is quite similar to the previous title, with the player determining Kōji's schedule and actions for each day. Work days are decided each Thursday for the following week, and each day is divided into three sections. In the morning, Kōji can take various actions such as to study, exercise, or visit various locations around town. In the afternoon, he must go to work, and different tasks will improve different attributes. In the evening, he can approach one of the girls to strike up a conversation. There are a total of eight possible romantic interests to pursue, and Kōji's attributes will determine which girls will be interested in him.

title: Tridonis
description: Tridonis is a pretty obscure RTS by a Polish development team.

title: Icarus Online
description: An MMORPG developed on CryEngine 3.

title: Don't Touch My Teddy Bear
description: A mobile game where players save a teddy bear from destruction by animals!

title: Stellar Mercenaries
description: Stellar Mercenaries is a futuristic 3D space combat and race simulator game for Windows 95 that was developed by the Canadian game company, Virtual Adventures Inc in 1997.

title: Legend of Mir
description:
In 1998 Wemade Entertainment released their first game under the Mir franchise, sadly no one outside of South Korea and China got opportunity to play. The project was abandoned very shortly after it's release and that's where it stayed until now.
Over the years screenshots were shared around old forums and little was known of the game that so little people managed to play or own.

title: Langrisser I & II
description:
A remake of the first and second Langrisser games for PlayStation 4 and Nintendo Switch.
Originally released on the Sega Megadrive/Genesis, the first game was called Warsong internationally while the second game was never released outside of Japan.

"The orthodox tactical simulation RPG "Langrisser" series sings in the present day!
Full remake of "I" & "II" as the origin of the series!
We bring back various elements such as visual refinement, full voice of scenario, optimization of UI and system side, and return on the latest platform!"

title: Puzzle Dungeon
description: Puzzle Dungeon is a Sokoban game for iOS combining nostalgic gameplay and graphics with modern controls, UI and concepts such as online leader-boards. It was created by Robert Lane

title: Flash Flash Revolution
description: Flash Flash Revolution (or FFR) is a music-based rhythm game that runs through an Adobe Air desktop application, making it a fully-fledged online music title that requires no fees to play. Players can choose from well over 2,000 songs from a number of genres, produced by popular signed and independent artists. Each game level has a pattern of arrows which correlate to the current song being played. The pattern of arrows scrolls from the bottom of the play field (by default) and players must hit the arrows when they meet the stationary receptors located at the top of the play field.

title: Lost Sector Online
description: Lost Sector Online is a Free-to-play squad-based, Tactical Strategy MMO Game combining, Turn Based Strategy (TBS) & MMORPG in real time.

title: Build-A-Lot: Mysteries
description: There’s mystery around every corner in these towns and one strange family is at the center of it all. Get ready for some spine-tingling fun as you work with eccentric members of the Graves Family to build, buy and flip houses in each of their eerie neighborhoods. Look for cryptic clues and earn fun achievements as you unearth the family’s peculiar talents, odd hobbies and questionable pasts. With three campaigns to play, it won’t take long for to you discover that some family secrets can’t stay buried forever.

title: Build-A-Lot: Fairy Tales
description: Travel across the fairy tale lands and create new houses and structures to make the world flourish.

title: Weathered
description: Weathered is a short experimental 'Noire style 1950's inspired Point and Click game'.

title: Wetware
description: Explore the interplays between AI ethics and consciousness in the shoes of a researcher tasked to hack an enemy drone to win a war.

title: The Useful Dead
description: The Useful Dead is a puzzle game where you have to die to progress. You control a horde of critically-stupid critters who can use each other’s dead bodies as stepping stones, to hold down buttons, prop open doors, etc. It features about 50 levels and is meant to be a simple, fun time.

title: Campfire Legends: The Last Act
description: Reggie and Ashley are on their way to surprise the campfire girls when an accident strands them deep in the middle of nowhere. When Reggie wakes up from the blackout, she realizes Ashley is gone and the only sign of life is a small light emanating from a mysterious mansion.

title: Campfire Legends: The Babysitter
description: Lisa is going to babysit twins and is looking forward for an evening of watching TV while the kids are asleep. But she is about to find out that this particular babysitting job is no easy money!

title: Campfire Legends: The Hookman
description: Christine finds her parents' cabin ransacked, but her boyfriend insists it was only hungry animals and takes them both on a romantic ride to the lake. What could go wrong?

title: Living Legends: Ice Rose
description: Living Legends: Ice Rose is the 1st installment of Living Legends Series by 4Friends Games. The game is based loosely on the tale of Snow Queen. In 2020, the game receives a remastered version, including updated graphic, soundtracks, and voice acting, making it more in line with the other games in the series.

title: Mystery Legends: Phantom of the Opera
description: Join Evelina uncover the secrets of the Opera house, now long abandoned after the incident with the Phantom, years beforehand.

title: Living Legends: Frozen Beauty
description: Living Legends: Frozen Beauty is the 2nd installment of Living Legends Series by 4Friends Games. The game is based loosely on the tale of Snow White. In 2020, the game receives a remastered version, with an increase in story content, updated graphics, alteration in some of the gameplay, and additional soundtracks.

title: Windborne
description: Windborne was a social sandbox game from Hidden Path Entertainment.

title: Kansei
description: Kansei is an interactive story game produced by SakeVisual, and the sequel to the murder mystery game Jisei. The story follows the journey of a teenager with the ability to relive the death of any corpse he touches.

title: Ballads of Reemus: When the Bed Bites
description: Point and click through an epic journey featuring Reemus the exterminator and the purple bear Liam.

title: Jisei
description: Jisei is a supernatural mystery game produced by sakevisual. A young teenager with no name and no home has the unique ability to relive the death of any corpse that he touches.

title: Savant
description: A shmup game developed by D-Pad Studio, featuring Norwegian musician Savant as lead character.

title: Sengoku Hime: Senran no Yo ni Honoo Tatsu
description: After a big war, various feudal lords gain power. Hojo, Uesugi, Imagawa, Mouri, Otomo, Oda, Shimazu, Satake, Date, Takeda and so on.... They fight each other and sometimes ally with others to expand territory for one and only goal.... Every feudal lord's ultimate goal is to conquer and unite the country....

title: Gamebiz 2
description: Gamebiz 2 is a managment/tycoon game about the video game industry. Players can develop new games for 37 different platforms including PC, NES, PS2, XBOX, C64, Amiga and more.

title: Gamebiz
description: In GameBiz, players manage a games development company. The goal is to make the best games for one or more of the nineteen different platforms in the game

title: ASA: A Space Adventure
description: ASA: A Space Adventure is a first-person node-based adventure game made in tribute to Riven and 2001: A Space Odyssey.

title: Black Wolves Saga: Bloody Nightmare
description: First game in the Black Wolves Saga series by otome game developer Rejet. The second game in the series, Last Hope, takes place in an alternate universe but otherwise follows the events of the first game.

title: Bitter Smile.
description: Visual novel about Yu Yazaki who returns to his hometown after being away for many years, and ends up living above a takoyaki shop run by three sisters.

title: Tourette's Quest
description: PC game from Lars Doucet, the developer behind Defender's Quest.

title: Exodus Guilty Alternative
description: An adult version of Exodus Guilty for the PC.

title: Doorways
description: Rescue your kitten from an alien force by travelling through portals masked as green doorways. What lies ahead for our hero? Probably not much good, although that might be up to you.

title: Miyako: Tsukiyomi no Yume
description:
A port for PC that adds an extra route.

Our story starts when a girl finds herself summoned by an Onmiyouji who claims that she is his shikigami “created” to do his bidding. The girl has no recollection of who she is but she feels like she was a human and her name is Sayuki. Sadly her new master, Abeno Seimei, is pretty demanding and tells her that if she doesn’t accept her fate as a shikigami, she will disappear. Seimei then brings her to Izumi at the capital to work, to do things like console quarraling married couples or deliver love letters. Unfortunately some of the jobs she has to do also require her to fight demons. Will she be able to get used to her new life as Shikigami #3?

title: Pom Gets Wi-Fi
description:
Made on RPGMaker 2003 with the intention of being the happiest, least scary game ever made on that engine.

Featuring:

* 2 endings!
* Over 20 dog breeds!
* 100 billion lines of dialogue

title: Slave of God
description: A multicolored, surreal trip through a pulsating nightclub.

title: Ronja Rövardotter
description: A point-and-click adventure game based on the popular Swedish children's book by Astrid Lindgren.

title: 3D Ms. Maze: Tropical Adventures
description:
3D Ms. Maze: Tropical Adventures is a single-player 3D Pac-Man variant that is very similar in style to 3D Maze Man: Amazing Adventures and Lady Cruncher which are from the same developer.

In this game the player takes Ms. Maze through twenty tropical themed levels gobbling up many varieties of fruit, avoiding obstacles, using secret passages and conveyor belts while avoiding ghosts unless a power up has been eaten.

title: 3D Maze Man: Adventures in Winter Wonderland
description: Holiday-themed levels with Maze Man

title: 3D Maze Man: Amazing Adventures
description: 3D Pac-Man clone released in 1998. Hasbro Entertainment sued and had production and distribution of the game ceased in 2000.

title: Pac-Guy: Christmas Edition
description: Pac-Guy: Christmas Edition is a short collection of holiday-themed Pac-Guy levels.

title: Chomperman
description: A freeware Pac-Man clone for PC released in 2005.

title: Nickelodeon 3D Movie Maker
description: A customized version of Microsoft 3D Movie Maker that includes settings and characters from various Nickelodeon TV Shows.

title: The Unbreakable Chain
description: A bizarre look at the food chain throughout the ages, by "Famicon", the UK art collective that brought you "Bart the General".

title: Yousei
description: For the past few years, Kangai has been a wanderer, but his return to his hometown has triggered a series of deaths linked to his past. He joins a group of psychic teenagers who solve mysteries under the watchful eye of the government. In Yousei, he and his group are sent undercover to a local university where they must dig up the remains of a top secret experiment. Upon arrival, they discover the project lead missing, and an old acquaintance racing them for the same information.

title: Rawbots
description: A universe where you can play with amazing robots that are designed, built and even programmed by you. Everything is a robot, doors, roads, walls, bridges, safes, traps, turrets, surveillance systems, etc. Build forts, towers and architect impressive structures to protect your planets and resources. You may play solo or with friends to infiltrate, conquer planets and gather resources.

title: Ultra Business Tycoon III
description: Popular Twine game from prominent interactive fiction designer and activist, Porpentine.

title: Crazy Cars: Hit the Road
description: The cult racing series created in 1988 by Palace Software is back with a brand new version faster than ever before! Rediscover the sheer thrill of arcade gaming with this amazing racing game, taking bends at max speed or massive jumps that can go hundreds of meters high. You'll be right in the middle of all the action, racing some of the best rides out there. Criss-cross different states of the USA at over 180 mph! Just make sure the cops don't catch you.

title: Camping Tycoon
description: Camping Tycoon is a management game about camping.

title: EuroCops
description:
EuroCops is a third-person shooter where the player takes a task force of three people through six European countries including France, Germany, the United Kingdom, Spain, Italy and Russia. The team needs to neutralize threads and can choose between six different agencies, such as GSG-9, NOCS, Team Alfa and the SAS. The player can only control one team member at a time, but issue general commands to the other two members such as "follow" or "hold". At any time, it is possible to directly take control of any of the other team members. This is useful as every agent has access to different weaponry, but the game also encourages the player to place agents in tactical positions to provide cover fire when entering new areas.

Missions consist of securing objectives and taking out the opposition. Weapons, ammo or health do not need to be collected. Each agent has a number of different weapons and can switch between them. These include handguns, shotguns, machine guns and sniper rifles. There is a zoom option, a melee attack and the agents can duck or prone when the situation requires it. A mini-map in the top right corner keeps track of enemy opposition and the location of objectives. Next to the singleplayer campaign mode, each unlocked mission becomes available in a cooperative multiplayer mode where each agent can be controlled by a different player.

title: Aranock Online
description: A free massively multiplayer online role playing game based on Mercenaries of Astonia by Daniel Brockhaus. Aranock Online has seen a significant amount of development over the years and still entertains a loyal few to this day. While increasingly showing its age, now more than ever it provides a refreshing take on the MMO genre and offers a unique gaming experience.

title: Virtual Cell
description: An educational game inspired equally by AP biology and Fantastic Voyage.

title: Against the Wall
description: Against the Wall is a first-person adventure game that takes place on an infinitely long wall.

title: Labyrinth of Touhou 2
description: Touhou no Meikyuu: Gensokyo to Tennuki no Daiju, or also known as Touhou no Meikyuu 2, is a dungeon crawler role-playing game and the sequel to the first Touhou no Meikyuu. Similar to its predecessor, Touhou no Meikyuu 2 challenges players with exploring and mapping an hug edungeon. The game uses a team of 4 characters and 8 reserve characters, and combat is be entirely turn-based. New features are available upon game completion are: Boss Rush Mode, available after recruiting 46 characters; And Enhanced Boss Rush Mode, unlocked after finishing Boss Rush Mode; Extra Areas - can be accessed from the 12th floor- with more enemies, treasure, and bosses.

title: Error #53
description: A game that purports to be a medieval-fantasy RPG. The game has allegedly been "cursed by an unknown force".

title: Baghdad Central: Desert Gunner
description: Protect your convoy from Iraqi insurgents in this on-rails shooter.

title: GuJian Online
description: The Legend of Ancient Sword is a Chinese classic game. The story describes a boy combine a sword Soul Until Died.

title: Catapult King
description: A casual game developed by Wicked Witch.

title: Qrth-Phyl
description: Arcade documentary of maze/dot/snake mechanic within changing dimensions, axis locks and the corruption of the system. Collect, grow, avoid your past, find new space, wake up...

title: Detonate
description: Building destruction simulator.

title: SpyLeaks
description: Uncover the mystery and save the world in this retro puzzler that also sports some old-school "shmup" action in between all the spying.

title: EverQuest II: Tears of Veeshan
description: Tears of Veeshan is the tenth expansion pack for EverQuest II.

title: Crypt Worlds
description: A freeware adventure game that tasks the player to explore a bizarre labyrinth.

title: Marisa and Alice's Trap Tower Remake
description: By Desunoya, this is the sequel to MariAri. In this doujin game Marisa and Alice are trapped inside a tower full of traps, and the player must control both characters alternately to navigate them through the puzzles. Co-operative play is also available.

title: Breath of Fire 6
description:
Breath of Fire 6: Hakuryū no Shugosha-tachi was a free-to-play online, web-based role-playing video game with microtransactions developed and published by Capcom as the sixth main installment of its Breath of Fire series. The game was released in Japan on February 24, 2016 for Microsoft Windows computers and Android devices, with an iOS release following on July 12, 2016.

On September 27, 2017, all services for Breath of Fire 6 officially closed, after only six of the game's eight planned episodes were released.

title: Internet Spades
description: A remake of Internet Spades included in Windows 7.

title: EverQuest: Call of the Forsaken
description: Call of the Forsaken is the twentieth expansion pack for the original EverQuest.

title: Internet Checkers
description: A remake of Internet Checkers included in Windows 7.

title: Internet Backgammon
description: A remake of Internet Backgammon included in Windows 7.

title: Pac-Guy: Atomic Edition
description: Pac-Guy's hometown gets nuked, and naturally, Pac-Guy wants revenge.

title: Curve Fever 2
description: Curve Fever 2 is a popular online flash game, primarily played on curvefever.com. It is the online predecessor of Curve Fever, which only supported offline play. In Curve Fever 2 you control a line that will get longer and longer. You play against up to 7 opponents and try to be the last one standing. Off course there will be less and less room to maneuver to, until you collapse in the wall or others.

title: Pea-Guy: Vengeance... or bust
description:
The second disc in the Pac-Guy series. Pac-Guy becomes Pea-Guy for a three-game CD-ROM adventure. It was changed from ''pac-guy'' to ''pea-guy'' for legal reasons.

The games included on this discc are:
Pea-Guy: Ultimeneinasenshun (The follow up to Pacula's Curse)
Pea-Guy: Arena (A competetive multiplayer game using an engine similar to Ultimeneinasenshun)
Pea-Guy Part 2: The Escape from Castle Ernie (the follow up to Ultimeneinasenshun)

title: Leithian: In the Abyss
description: A South Korean action RPG for the PC developed by Garam & Baram.

title: Judith
description: A first-person game about a mysterious murder.

title: Ski Racing 2006 - Featuring Hermann Maier
description: Downhill skiing game.

title: Redemption Cemetery: Curse of the Raven
description: Redemption Cemetery: Curse of the Raven is a hidden objects game.

title: The Secret of Margrave Manor
description: The Secret of Margrave Manor is a hidden objects game for the PC.

title: Kabus 22
description: Kabus 22 is a horror–action game set in Kadiköy district in Istanbul. The player takes control of three characters; the Turkish soldier Demir, his girlfriend Ebru and the mysterious Inzar. These characters have to fight against a despot religious order and creatures which are named Maduns in an alternate near future.

title: Master Bill
description:
Master Bill is a sequel to the logic game Engineer.
Our plan is collecting various bonuses, avoid traps and proper assembly of tubes. Game only on PC.

title: Resurrection: The Return of the Black Dragon
description: Resurrection is a combination of action and adventure game, facing a third-person fantasy set in reality, in which the three heroes must join forces to defeat a dangerous enemy. Made by Dinamic Multimedia. Availible only on PC.

title: Asakura! P
description: Asakura! P is a side-scrolling 2D hardcore action platformer developed by Somiso and released at Comiket 80.

title: Shariki
description: Shariki (Russian: Balloons) is the original match three game. It was developed by Russian programmer Eugene Alemzhinym for DOS in 1994. The goal of the game is to gain progressively higher scores by matching three or more balls of the same color in a line (vertical or horizontal), by swapping adjacent balls. Each swap must result in a match. Matched balls are then removed, and new ones drop from the top to fill the gaps. The game is over when no more matches are possible in the game field.

title: netKar Pro
description: netKAR Pro is a racing game with a strong focus on realism. The player uses one of the five cars to race on one of the five courses. The game is aimed at motor sport enthusiasts as there are no driving help features and it uses telemetry data also used by professionals - of course the player has a lot of options to customize his car's settings. Other features are the interactive cockpit and the physics which take real-world details into account, e.g. dirt on the tires. Single player is restricted to races against the clock, but the main aspect of the game are the online races against other players.

title: Ferrari Virtual Academy
description: Collaborative racing simulation between Kunos Simulazioni and Ferrari

title: Mahjong Royal Towers
description: Mahjong solitaire game with a medieval theme.

title: Kanye Quest 3030
description: Kanye Quest 3030 is a hip-hop-themed science-fiction 2D roleplaying game starring Kanye West.

title: Seal: Travelers of Destiny
description: A Korean RPG developed by Garam & Baram in 2000 for the PC.

title: Pac-Guy: Resurrection
description: Pac-Guy: Resurrection is an action game and spoof of Pac-Man. The game itself is a "resurrection" of the original Pac-Guy that include the original 12 levels with an additional new level from which you must eat all of the pellets while avoiding Kan's attacks. You navigate a maze collecting pellets while avoiding enemies. Big pellets act as ammunition that you can fire at enemies to remove them from the level permanently. Once you collect all the pellets and find the exit (sometimes automatic), you proceed to the next level. Losing all of your lives will merely send you back to the previous stage.

title: Gooka
description: Gooka is the Czech cartoon point-and-click adventure game.

title: Front Page Sports: Ski Racing
description: Blast down world class mountain slopes at speeds averaging 80 MPH in this 3D ski racing computer game from 1997.

title: Love Sniper
description: A comedy visual novel about a boy who tried to win his crush's heart.

title: Nancy the Happy Whore and the Perfidious Petrol Station
description: An indie point and click adventure game.

title: Mystery Stories: Mountains of Madness
description: Mystery Stories: Mountains of Madness is a mystery game from Big Fish Games.

title: The Lost Inca Prophecy
description: The Lost Inca Prophecy is a PC puzzle game from Seppia Interactive.

title: UemeU
description: UemeU (You-Me-You) is a 3D multiplayer sandbox where players can build large interactive worlds.

title: Paca Plus Minus
description: A prequel to Paca Plus about how Kazuma and Yukari began dating, per alpaca transformation.

title: Sexy Hiking
description:
Sexy Hiking is a freeware physics-based platformer for PC created by Jazzuo.

This is the game that inspired Bennett Foddy to develop Getting Over It with Bennett Foddy.

title: Tridek: Creatures of Galena
description:
The first cross platform digital trading card game. Planned for release on iOS, Android, Mac and PC.
Created by Bit Barons and dreamfab.

title: Swarm Assault
description: Swarm Assault is a real time strategy game where you battle with swarms of ants, beetles, spiders, scorpions and wasps to control the map. Each of the 5 Colonies have 3 units you can build, there is no resource management as the stronger the unit is the longer it takes to hatch. In total there is 100 levels to progress through based on 4 different terrain types, also a level creator to generate your own maps.

title: Which
description: A short horror game where you look for a way to open the door out of the small house.

title: Ending
description: A minimalist and challenging turn-based puzzle game and roguelike.

title: Neftelia
description: Neftelia is a freeware game of uncertain origin.

title: Master of the Skies: The Red Ace
description: WWI dogfighting game.

title: Close Combat: The Longest Day
description:
Close Combat is a pausable real-time wargame series, heavily focused on historical accuracy and realistic soldier psychological profiles. Team management is crucial as every man in your teams matter. in Close Combat: the Longest Day take command of either the Allied Expeditionary Force or Germany’s Wehrmacht.

Remake of Close Combat: Invasion of Normandy.

title: Close Combat: Wacht am Rhein
description:
Close Combat is a pausable real-time wargame series, heavily focused on historical accuracy and realistic soldier psychological profiles. Team management is crucial as every man in your teams matter. In Close Combat: Wacht am Rhein, you take command of US or German forces and either retrace the last steps of Hitler’s army in one desperate attempt to turn the tide of the impending allied victory or ride to the rescue with General Patton and push back the German offensive to reclaim Bastogne. 
 
Remake of Close Combat: The Battle of the Bulge.

title: Close Combat: Cross of Iron
description: Close Combat: Cross of Iron is an enhanced remake of the critically acclaimed real time strategy game, Close Combat III: The Russian Front by Atomic Games. Playing as either the Germans or Russians, the game takes place during WWII on the Russian Front, where as a commander you must lead your troops through five years of brutal combat.

title: Close Combat: RAF Regiment
description: Close Combat RAF Regiment is a tactical decision-making simulator which will become part of the British Royal Air Force's training program.

title: Nuke the Dinosaurs Blueprint Prototype
description:
Nuke the Dinosaurs Blueprint Prototype is a pinball game created during the Mojam 2.

It was a surprise title worked on by Junkboy, Aron, Jon, and Steven (from Surasshu Sound), but they’ve decided to release the blueprint prototype early.

title: Battle Frogs
description: Battle Frogs is a shooter created during the Mojam 2.

title: Nuclear Pizza War
description: Nuclear Pizza war is a strategy game created during Mojam 2 by members of the Mojang team.

title: Choice of Broadsides
description: Discover who you are as a sailor in this choice-based text adventure for iOS.

title: Furuiro Meikyuu Rondo
description: Visual novel about a boy who told the wheel of fate is out of balance, and he will die within a week if he cannot fix it.

title: Tunnelers
description: Free to play multiplayer shooter set in 2159, in which player controls and customizes his own tank and takes it into battles for extremely rare mineral called Carretium against other players.

title: Hamtaro: Wake Up Snoozer!
description: Hamtaro and his friends must wake up the ever-sleepy Snoozer.

title: Tektonik
description: Created during Mojam 2, Tektonic is a fast-paced game to reach the core of a planet.
Created in the Mojam 2, 3918 is a multiplayer space shooter where the aim is to destroy the enemy team's homebase.

title: Pioneers
description: Pioneers is an open source rendition of 'Settlers of Catan.'

title: Trigger Rally
description:
Trigger Rally is a 3D car racing game written in C++ by Jasmine Langridge and Richard Langridge. It is licensed under the GPL and a BSD-like license.

It supports keyboard, joystick, or joypad control, and anaglyph stereo output.

title: Performous
description: Performous is an open-source karaoke/music playing game.

title: Jack Claw
description: Destroy the world and your enemies with an extendable claw in this third-person fighting game.

title: Avert Fate
description: Avert Fate is a futuristic FPS that challenges you to survive in several difficulty modes.

title: Advanced Strategic Command
description:
Advanced Strategic Command is a free (GPL), turn-based strategy wargame developed by Martin Bickel, who was a fan of Blue Byte's Battle Isle series but wanted to create a more robust game in the same tradition with greater moddability. The game was completed in development in 2013 and has had updates from time to time since.

Playable in single player and multiplayer mode via LAN, hot-seat mode, or Internet, the game features several playing modes, most of them intended for games against other human players, including a single-player campaign mode.

The map editor can be used to create own maps. If offers a great variety of terrain textures and buildings.

The latest build released for general usage, version 2.6.0, was released in early 2021.

title: Soul Saga
description: A love letter to J-RPG classics from the Playstation era like Final Fantasy, Breath of Fire, Suikoden, and Persona.

title: Shin Koihime Musou: Fighting Maidens of the Romance of the Three Kingdoms
description: A 2D fighting game spin-off from the Koihime Musou franchise, where where the generals of the Romance of the Three Kingdoms have been reimagined as anime heroines.

title: Liege
description: Liege is a party-based, tactical role-playing game for PC, Mac, iOS and Android. The game takes the classic JRPG formula and layer in a mature story, tactical gameplay and hand-drawn visuals.

title: Nanosaur II: Hatchling
description: As a genetically-engineered pterodactyl, players fight against insurgent dinosaur forces in order to save Earth.

title: Curve Fever
description: Curve Fever is a high-energy, multiplayer snake game with powers. Survive each round and battle-it-out online against opponents, utilizing your own customized ship to win. Climb the ranked ladder and level up, earning new powers with each new level!

description: Learning adventures with Dr. Seuss characters.

title: Saint Seiya Typing: Ryu Sei Ken
description: Learn to type with the popular anime series.

title: The Unlikely Legend of Rusty Pup
description: The Unlikely Legend of Rusty Pup is a 2D platformer with a strong focus on character and a sad story seasoned with dark humor. It is developed by the creator of Conker's Bad Fur Day and ex-RARE staffer Chris Seavor.

title: Quacker Blaster
description: An open source game for Linux, Mac, and PC.

title: Blitz Brigade
description: Blitz Brigade is an online first person shooter for mobile devices.

description: Released in 1998 for the PlayStation, Jingle Cats is a game where you help cats get along. The goal is to get two specific cats to become friends.

description: A free-to-play multiplayer FPS currently in closed beta.

title: The Sushi Spinnery
description: The Sushi Spinnery is a management simulation game from Kairosoft, available for iOS and Android platforms. In the game, you build and manage a sushi restaurant, hire and train staff, craft new recipes, enter sushi competitions, and try to please customers.

title: GeoGuessr
description: A game of simulated world travel and geographical knowledge. Players must pinpoint their location on the map after being placed in a random Street View location.

title: Franchise Hockey Manager 2013
description: Franchise Hockey Manager is a hockey sports management game. The player can take control of any team in 19 playable leagues, including NHL, AHL, KHL and many other European elite leagues, as well as North American minor and junior leagues. A team is led to success by managing every aspect of hockey team: roster management, contracts and player trades, coaching, scouting, finances. Furthermore, you can create your own custom league, fill it with your fictional teams and players, set the rules and play.

title: City Sandbox
description: City Sandbox is a cartoon, side-view city builder, that allows players to create and destroy miniature 2D cities.

title: Artifact Red-X
description: A strategy game for PC and iOS devices.

title: Riot Police
description: Riot Police is an isometric real time strategy game where you are the commander of Metro City Police Force. Throughout 16 different missions (and 1 extra bonus) in Metro City, you try to achieve various goals like keeping property damage to a minimum or capturing a specific criminal in real time. The game lets you command an increasing amount of pre-selected units and use them to achieve your goals as you see fit. The civilians respond to your actions directly, where capturing a criminal will make them happy and assaulting an unproven suspect will create rioters.

title: Erie
description: You are dropped into a terrifying scenario where your goals are to investigate, survive, and escape.

title: Tale of a Hero
description: An adventure game developed by Future Games.

title: SD Gundam Capsule Fighter Online
description: A free to play MMO shooter put out by OGPlanet. Players can take control of chibi versions of mobile suits from the many different Mobile Suit Gundam cartoons to fight it out in PvP, or work together on PvE missions.

title: Tenshi Doumei
description:
Tenshi Doumei combines battlefield tactics and mech upgrades for an entertaining title. At face value, Tenshi is a tactical strategy RPG where you move units and attack or defend against cadres of adversaries.

Attacks consist of long range artillery attacks and close-range bouts where you invariably punch an enemy mech. The drawback of a punch is that the opponent will counter-attack within the close range. A long range fire attack will not prompt any return fire. Close range attacks are preferable in the first few levels because they inflict more damage.

title: Royal Envoy 2
description: A casual time-management and city building game.

title: Samurai vs Zombies Defense
description: Play as the heroic Samurai and defend your village against hordes of attacking zombies! Recruit allies and build defenses to stop them!

title: Indiemon: Earth Nation
description: A Pokemon-esque game developed by RicolaVG. Play as a Indiemon tamer named Landon and capture and train Indiemon to fight intruders!

title: Mirai no Kimi to, Subete no Uta ni
description:
A visual novel game developed by Supplement Time.
"With You in the Future, and to All Songs" was first sold at Comiket 73. Its about the daily lives of the user and Vocaloid - Hatsune Miku.

title: Dr. Seuss Kindergarten
description: Learning adventures with Dr. Seuss characters.

title: Cursed Fates: The Headless Horseman
description: A hidden object game for PC and Mac.

title: Dream Inn: Driftwood
description: A hidden object game for PC and Mac.

title: Barn Yarn
description: A hidden object game for PC.

title: Gardenscapes 2
description: Gardenscapes 2 takes the unique experience of the original Gardenscapes to a completely new level! The garden at the estate where Austin was born and grew up in is in a pitiful state. Rundown and neglected, it is waiting for you to come and restore it! Accompany Austin to the place of his childhood, meet his parents, and collect the old photos and other memorable things from his past. Run sales of the old stuff found around the house to implement the original decor ideas of your own! Help your good old friend bring the family garden to bloom again in this brand new hit from Playrix!

title: Camelot Unchained
description: Camelot Unchained is an in-development fantasy massively multiplayer online role-playing game from City State Entertainment which was partially funded through Kickstarter. Leading its production is Mark Jacobs, the former designer of Dark Age of Camelot.

title: Fear for Sale: Nightmare Cinema
description: A hidden object game for PC and Mac.

title: Silent Nights: The Pianist
description: Save your sister and uncover the secrets of an ancient organization. You and your sister, Yvette, come from a long line of gifted musicians. When you arrive to accompany her at a vocal concert in your hometown, you discover she has been abducted by a mysterious group with plans to use her talent for a dire purpose. Explore hidden object scenes and get to the bottom of things before your sister’s voice is silenced forever.

title: Enigma Agency: The Case of Shadows
description: A hidden object game for PC.

title: Secrets of the Dark: Mystery of the Ancestral Estate
description: "Mystery of the Ancestral Estate" is the third game in the Secrets of the Dark series. Like the first two it is a hidden object game. Screens have a list of objects that need to be found. Each object found is struck off the list. Items gathered during your journey are stored in an inventory. These items are then used to solve puzzles in the hope of obtaining a piece of the house's lamp. As before light and dark needs to be manipulated in order to discover items and puzzles that need completing. Puzzles need to be solved and vary in difficulty. Hints can be used to find hidden objects, to provide assistance as to what to do next or to skip puzzles.

title: Dark Tales: Edgar Allan Poe's The Masque of the Red Death
description: A hidden object game for PC and Mac.

title: Magic Match: Journey to the Lands of Arcane
description: Magic Match: Journey to the Lands of Arcane is a match 3 style puzzle game from Codeminion.

description: A stand alone expansion for Aselia the Eternal, retelling the final chapter chapter with new story paths and endings.

description: A third-person arena combat game by the Japanese indie developer Souvenir Circ.

title: Dary's Legend
description: Dary's Legend is a graphical hand-drawn, roguelike dungeon crawler game. Help Dary as he embarks on a journey full of perils, monsters, traps and treasures.

title: Toy Cars
description: Toy Cars is a top-down racing game developed for the PC and XBox Live Indie Games. It's been conceived as both a homage and an evolution of classic top-down arcade racers. In it players control pocket-sized vehicles around table-top tracks built from all manner of everyday objects.

title: Sabre Ace: Conflict Over Korea
description: Sabre Ace: Conflict Over Korea is an air and ground-attack combat flight simulation game which takes place in the skies above Korea. The Korean War was fought between the Soviet Union and the United States using North & South Koreans and free world troops, using the country of Korea as a battleground. Choose to be a pilot for the USA in American aircraft, or on the side of the Koreans in Russian planes.

title: Osada
description: Weird musical click-and-follow game from the makers of Machinarium.

title: Raging Tiger: The Second Korean War
description: Raging Tiger: The Second Korean War is an extremely complicated strategy game from ProSIM Company and Shrapnel Games.

title: MonkeyRoids
description: MonkeyRoids is a space shooter developed for PC Gamer magazine.

title: Valkyrie no Densetsu Gaiden: Rosa no Bouken
description: Graphic adventure spinoff of the Legend of Valkyrie series

title: My Forged Wedding
description: In My Forged Wedding, the player takes on the role of a recent university graduate who must trade a few days in a false marriage for the job of her dreams.

title: Little Monster Private Eye: The Mummy Mystery
description: Little Monster Private Eye: The Mummy Mystery is a point-and-click children's game made by Infogrames in 2001. It stars Little Monster Private Eye and his faithful talking Kerploppus that is simply called "Detective Kerploppus," created by Mercer Mayer (whom also created Little Critter, and the game was produced and released at the same time as a similar game featuring Little Critter was made, Little Critter and the Great Race). It is more or less a straight-forward Adventure Game compared to the game it preceded, The Smelly Mystery. The story involves Little Monster Private Eye and Detective Kerploppus being called onto a case where Professor Pickle is stuck at the Tomb of Thanxfurnuten.

title: Little Monster Private Eye: The Smelly Mystery
description: Game on the PC.

description: A sci-fi comedy adventure game that combines interplanetary exploration, puzzle-solving, and space travel- not to mention “pant loads” of pop culture satire and some good, clean “potty” humor.

title: RPG Tsukuuru 95
description: The first Windows incarnation of the RPG Maker series.

title: Hidden Dawn
description: A fantasy themed adventure game published by E-One Studio.

title: Venus Hostage
description: An erotic thriller themed first person shooter with some puzzles developed and published by Mirage-lab.

title: Mage's Initiation
description: D'arc is a sixteen-year-old Mage to be. A sinister plot threatens his initiation and risks plunging the land of Iginor into conflict and chaos. Choose from four classes and train in the Elemental arts. Master a unique range of spells to solve puzzles, battle monsters, and confront the ultimate evil.

title: Alter Ego: DreamWalker
description: Alter Ego: DreamWalker is the sequel to the 2011 action puzzle platform title Alter Ego. In this game, you have a phantom 'alter ego' that mirrors all your moves (either horizontally or vertically) from across the screen. You can switch between the hero and his alter ego a limited number of times in each level, in order to avoid enemies and reach otherwise inaccessible positions. The ZX-Spectrum version uses multicolor, a software technique to combine more colours than normally possible without colour clash.

title: Vivian Clark
description: Vivian Clark is a game about perspective. It was originally discovered as an entirely separate game hidden within Soda Drinker Pro.

title: Super Comboman
description: A 2D beat 'em up game published by Interabang Entertainment.

title: Battle Cry of Freedom
description:
Battle Cry of Freedom brings brutal real-time first and third-person combat set in the 19th Century America, presenting players with the opportunity to re-fight the American Civil War as either the Union or the Confederacy.

Incorporating a wide range of weaponry, from long range rifled muskets and devastating artillery, to various deadly close combat tools such as bayonets, knives and sabres, players will take up the fight for the North or the South trying to win the day on the bloody battlefields of America.

title: Eyes: The Horror Game
description: Eyes: The Horror Game is a terrifying game of hide-and-seek where you play as a thief collecting hidden money bags inside a haunted building while avoiding deadly ghosts you cannot fight.

title: PuppetShow: Destiny Undone
description: PuppetShow: Destiny Undone is 5th game in PuppetShow series, developed by ERS Games.

title: Swimsanity!
description:
Swimsanity! is a multiplayer underwater shooter with action-packed Co-Op and Versus game modes, all supported by online and local play. You play as our hero Mooba, who uses a variety of unique power ups and weapons to survive in this aquatic world.

Whether you're teaming up with friends to swim into Adventure mode, or clashing in competitive matches such as Last Mooba Standing, there's more than 150+ challenges to complete across 8 action-packed Game Modes in Swimsanity! All modes can be played online or locally.

4 PLAYER ONLINE CO-OP!
