Team up to unlock content and complete challenges with players around the world.

4 PLAYER ONLINE VERSUS!
Join casual or ranked matches to compete and climb the Leaderboards to be crowned the best in the world.

LOCAL CO-OP AND VERSUS!
Feel the intensity in the room with some couch play with up to four friends. If anyone's missing, play with bots fill their spot.

ONLINE CROSS-PLAY!
Play with anyone online across the Xbox One, PC and Consoles!

UNLEASH SWIMSANITY!
Unlock 10+ eye-popping Unleashes to bring to battle for devastating moves.

COMPLETE 150+ CHALLENGES!
There's always more to do by completing over 150 challenges across 8 Game Modes.

title: Doritos Crash Course Go!
description: Doritos Crash Course comes to the Windows 8

title: Castle Infinity
description:
Castle Infinity is an MMOG (Massive Multiplayer Online Game) designed for children as young as age 8. It emphasizes cooperative problem solving using non-violent methods in a colorful, imaginative atmosphere. Essentially it is a side-scrolling platformer with adventure puzzles. The main objective of this arcade-style game is to amass enough power points and earned objects to battle and remove the monsters that have penetrated the dinosaurs' sanctuary.

Castle Infinity is a discontinued Massively multiplayer online game, the first intended for children. It was launched by Starwave Corporation in 1996, and features personalized avatars, an embedded message system and live chat in a 2D side scrolling game world. It survives as a freeware MMOG.

title: Voodoo Chronicles: The First Sign
description:
Help out James Voodoo as he investigates mysterious attacks through the forsaken hamlet of Ravenhill, the wealthy city of Richtown, and a variety of breathtaking sceneries inspired by major fiction genres: adventure, film noir, thriller, steam punk, and more!

With over 50 scenes to investigate, numerous puzzles, oodles of hidden objects to find, and a captivating story told through cut scenes and voice acting, "Voodoo Chronicles: The First Sign" will let you embark on an adventure you won't want to stop!

title: Sangoku Rensenki: Otome no Heihou!
description: Yamada Hana, a high school girl, woke up and found herself in a strange land after being enveloped by a bright light that came out from a mysterious book. There, Hana met a young man named Gentoku, and ended up staying with him and his army as "Koumei's disciple"…

title: Phantasmaburbia
description: Phantasmaburbia is a turn-based RPG running on the Game Maker engine.

title: Vampires!
description: An interesting puzzle with an unusual idea. Play as a hunter for human lives and help feed your pet. In this case, try not to perish yourself.

title: Edgar Torronteras' Moto-X 2000
description: Edgar Torronteras' Moto-X 2000 is a PC Motocross game developped by Deibus Studios and released in April 2000

title: European Mystery: Scent of Desire
description: PC

title: Azada: Elementa
description: PC

title: Judge Dredd vs. Zombies
description:
You must protect Mega-City One from a zombie invasion! Arm yourself with a Lawgiver pistol and three other devastating, upgradable weapons. Fight four deadly zombie archetypes in thirty levels of game play. Choose from seven special upgrades to give you an edge over your undead foe.

Earn stars and commendations based on performance. Ensure your Law meter is kept to maximum at all times by eliminating zombies, collecting shields and avoiding damage. Watch your ammo count as you blast through waves of attacking undead. When the going gets tough, upgrade your Lawgiver or try the Spitgun, Scattergun or Hi-Ex Launcher. Immerse yourself in a future world where the extreme is the norm.

title: Lonely Yuri
description:
"First with a kiss... the girl is etched in the protagonist's mind.

It was first year in high school. The budding of summer.
Fusa Konno met a shut-in girl named Seri.
Persecuted by her yearning eyes, her heart gradually opened...

Night-time Sheep presents a highly atmospheric romance yuri visual novel"

title: Arena of Heroes
description: A turn based MOBA game for PC, Mac, iOS

title: Cult County
description: Renegade Kid's new episodic Horror-FPS originally planned for the Nintendo 3DS eShop. On April 2, 2014 Renegade Kid announced the game was evolved into a console game and went to Kickstarter while the 3DS version has been canceled. The game will be made even if the Kickstarter fails but it will take a lot longer, according to Renegade Kid.

title: Mujintou Monogatari 4
description:
Mujintou Monogatari 4 is a "survival life simulation" game and is essentially a retelling of the first game. A plane crashes into the sea, but a child survives and wakes up on a seemingly deserted island. The child finds another survivor and a cabin with a few basic supplies. After watching the lengthy intro, the player is given both heroes to manage. Water, food, light sources and materials have to be gathered and new tools can be crafted, provided the characters have all the necessary materials and knowledge.

Compared to the original game, Mujintou Monogatari 4 changes the gameplay to make it more of an Action RPG, with players having to control the characters using a mouse and double-clicking on an item or enemy to gather or attack it. Players can find other survivors and have control of 3 unique pairs of characters which can explore various areas of the island. Each character's statistics can change depending on the activities that players make them do.

title: The Thirty Nine Steps
description: An interactive story based on John Buchan's classic novel The Thirty-Nine Steps, made for PC, Mac, Linux, and tablets.

title: Galactic Reign
description: This turn-based space strategy game of expansion and conquest features gorgeous cloud-rendered battle sequences, and the ability to move seamlessly between Windows 8 and Windows Phone devices.

title: Emergency Ambulance Simulator
description: Emergency! Help people! With an ambulance! But not really because it's a simulation.

title: Tower of Elements
description: A tower defense game where the combat consists of match-3 puzzles.

title: Dizzel
description: A jigsaw puzzle game for PC.

title: Black Eagle 2
description:
Russia, the year 2068. In a top-secret research institute, a prototype of self-learning artificial intelligence has been developed, designed to completely rid military equipment of human presence.

To test the performance and combat effectiveness in all possible conditions, a TA-420 Scorpion tank is being created - a heavily armed nuclear-powered combat vehicle.

On the first test launch in the system of restriction and deterrence, an error occurs, the machine gets out of control, destroys all training objectives, kills a group of researchers and breaks through the protective perimeter of the test site, leaves the test zone.

title: GL Tron
description: GL Tron is an open source game based on Tron's iconic Light Cycle scene.

title: Low Light Combat
description: Low Light Combat is a free competitive multiplayer shooter where light is your only weapon. Matches take place during a rapidly changing day and night cycle, meaning your fast paced fights quickly become tense and thrilling battles of wit. In LLC, your health, ammo, and stamina are all tied to a single resource: Time. That means everything from firing your weapon and taking damage, to sprinting and shining your flashlight will all deplete your time. To replenish your time you must either defeat other players, or touch the reactor found in the middle of the map. But you must act fast because time... is fleeting.

title: Clan Lord
description: A top-down 2D MMO with a simple bump to attack interface. Has regular updates every three weeks. The first graphical MMO for Macintosh, now also for PC.

title: Reef Shot
description: Explore the Pacific as an underwater photographer and discover the mysteries of a sunken ancient city. Unwind in the depths of the ocean and submerge yourself in the atmospheric world and music.

title: Super Air Combat
description: The first entry in SystemSoft's Air Combat series to be available for Windows, this is an arcade flight simulator featuring experimental and even fictional futuristic jet fighters.

title: Spider-Man Cartoon Maker
description: The Spider-Man Cartoon Maker was a computer disc that you could insert into a PC, enabling you to easily design basic cartoons. This software featured settings and characters from Spider-Man: The Animated Series.

title: Densha de GO! Professional 2
description:
Densha de Go! Professional-shiyou 2 (loosely translated to "Go by Train! Professional Specification 2") is an electric train driving simulation game developed and published by Taito for the PlayStation 2 in Japan on October 25, 2002. It was later ported to the PC by Unbalance on April 30, 2003.

The sequel to the 1999 home console entry in the Densha De Go! series, Densha de Go! Professional-shiyou, Professional-shiyou 2 features a graphical upgrade and a new set of real-life train routes: the Shōnan-Shinjuku Line, the Tsurumi Line, the Kosei Line, the Seto-Ōhashi Line, and the Nagasaki Main Line to Sasebo Line. One new feature added to the series is the ability to save and resume route progress, and to start progress from a designated station.

title: Densha de GO! Shinkansen: Sanyou Shinkansen-hen
description:
Densha de Go! Shinkansen: Sanyoushinkansen-hen (loosely translated to "Go by Train! Shinkansen: Sanyou Shinkansen Edition") is an electric train driving simulation game developed and published by Taito for the PlayStation 2 in Japan on September 20, 2001. It was later ported to the PC by Unbalance on December 13, 2002.

A spin-off of the Densha de Go! series, Shinkansen focuses on the titular high-speed rail line San'yō Shinkansen (through the entire route both ways, between Shin-Ōsaka and Hakata).

The game was later ported to the Wii as Densha de Go! Shinkansen EX: Sanyoushinkansen-hen (loosely translated to "Go by Train! Shinkansen EX: Sanyou Shinkansen Edition") on March 1, 2007. This version features a new "Kids Mode" utilizing the Wii Remote's motion control.

title: The Broadside Express
description: One-third of the Humble Bundle Mojam, The Broadside Express is a Unity-powered Steampunk Action-Strategy game.

title: River City Melee: Battle Royal Special
description: This is the most recent installment of the Kunio-Kun franchise recreated as a fun and easy fighting game with the fighting aspects taken and upgraded from River City Super Sports Challenge All Star Special.

title: King Exit
description: Because of the Great hero Galoluise, demons are all destroyed.For a rookie teenage girl to become the Savior, everyone loved her.Life seemed happy, and the world was as peace as it could ever get.But 3 years later,Hero Galoluise not only have lost her house, her friends and family members were slaughtered.

title: Shroom
description: Make it through levels, shooting your way through hoards of monsters commanded by an evil shroom.

title: Temple Escape
description: A simple and fun arcade game in which you can become a real adventurer, escaping from mortal danger. Aid your explorer and help him escape the ancient temple!

title: Otaku's Fantasy
description:
I was a deadbeat.
After times and times of getting fire, I worked as a cleanup crew, just trying to make a living. When I got nothing to do, I can only play with myself. Later a AI company took me in, I thought the job will just be slightly better than the last one. i just want a new life, a better one.

But it's like a different world! Office ladies from powerful companies, celebrities, and rich cugars. This is all too much for an otaku like me.

One day, a cute actress called my name and said 'Hey are you a boy or a girl?' I was so angry my vains were about to pop. So I just whipped it out. The next day everyone call me ladyboy.

From then on, a new world had opened the door for me. All kinds of women threw themselves at me, and for all kinds of strange reasons. No matter it is a mixed-race lady with huge buttocks, a well-known news anchor secretly wants to be whipped, or a hungry cugar that almost eats me up, they all wants to know what it's like to be with me. But there's no stopping this!

This is otaku's dream world, if you want 'em, just get 'em!

title: Butterfly Moment
description: Catch pretty little butterflies while admiring great views. Relax, unwind and let your rhythm guide you.

title: KendamVR: Virtual Reality Kendama
description: KendamVR Is the world's first virtual reality Kendama game!

title: Goldrushers
description:
A Goldrush themed local multiplayer brawler for PC and Mac!
Play as two competing prospectors trying to fill your safes with precious gold nuggets or other items of value.
Goldrushers will provide fast paced action, wacky antics, and flying horses for your living room.

title: aMaze Achievements: darkness
description: aMaze Achievements: darkness is a single-player top down 3D adventure game. This is the first game in "aMaze Achivements" series.

title: Burger in Partyland
description: Everything is possible when you are a burger in Partyland! Pass through every stage, cheat every obstacle not to consume you but to let you pass further into Partyland.

title: Bones game online
description: This game is a simulator of a board game.

title: The Armament Project
description: The Armament Project is a Science Fiction First Person Shooter.

title: Octopus Bar
description: Enter this hidden izakaya bar hidden deep in the magical forest, where the octopus serves you, fish float into the sky, and a frog enjoys the your company while smoking his pipe. In this world the impossible is now possible and you are invited to discover the games and enjoy this whimsical scenery.

title: Pembrey
description: Two young film makers travel out deep into the Pembrey Forest in search for footage for their documentary. Record and document your findings and unravel the truth behind the famous "Pembrey Forest".

title: Jamie's Dream
description: Jamie's Dream is a short, emotional, experimental, psychological horror narrative experience. Walk through nightmares, facing fears and memories as they are revealed going deeper and deeper into the abyss of Jamie's mind.

title: Oses
description: Command 3 characters and use strategy to survive on this post-apocalyptic shooter.

title: eSports Life
description: eSports Life is the utmost professional gamer simulator which includes the best clubs. Build your career as a top electronic athlete and become a magnate in the eSports industry.

title: Elisa: Seduce the Innkeeper
description: The player doesn't impersonate a simple man, but a powerful, rich and famous nobleman who seems to be able to obtain whatever he wishes for. But will this be enough this time?

title: Number World
description:
Move all tiles and merge similar Numbers when they touch.
Brake chains, melt the ice and overcome other obstacles to join the pieces to fulfil tasks on your numerical puzzle adventure in the Number World!
Play 120 levels in the quest mode or set the highest score in various Challenge modes.

title: Dawn of a Soul
description: Dawn of a Soul is a mathematical puzzle game about creating perfectly balanced paths by building chains and combos.

title: Ringognir 2
description: Ringognir 2 is a nice little puzzle game that could cost you a lot of your time and nerves. Your goal is to build spheres with rings and match the line of the same color. As you progress your levels get harder and harder and new colors come into play.

title: Hex: Origins
description: Hex: Origins is a casual puzzle game based on a complete hexagon themed colorful experience. Enjoy a refreshing, calming and original experience, which is extremely easy to pick up but hard to master as you progress in the game. Across the multitude of game modes and levels you will encounter, you must place pieces composed of anywhere from 2 to 10 and more hexagons, each using up to 6 different colors.

title: Sweaty Palms
description: Climb, swing, fly, and shoot in this VR multiplayer action arena. Fight like a superhero, die like one.

title: End of Days
description: End of Days is an open world horror survival game set in a time where a virus has mutated human beings into the “infected”. A world where players must work together to survive or eliminate the other survivors.

title: Mayas' Virtual Brush
description:
Mayas' Virtual Brush is as 3D Painting and Sculpting tool with a friendly interface and simple controls that allows you to create whole new worlds, achieving breath-taking results with just a few simple strokes. 
 
It doesn’t matter if you are a beginner or a professional, with Mayas' Virtual Brush anyone can create something truly new and inspiring!

title: Shapes8
description: The goal is to draw each level's shape in just one move - that means that going over the same line more than once is not allowed! There are lots of different shapes that make levels in this game, some of them are easier to draw, and some of them not so much easy.

title: Shapes7
description: The goal is to draw each level's shape in just one move - that means that going over the same line more than once is not allowed! There are lots of different shapes that make levels in this game, some of them are easier to draw, and some of them not so much easy.

title: Disney Fairies: Hidden Treasures
description: After discovering her talent, Tinker Bell invents, builds and repairs new contraptions to make life easier for her fairy friends. Your child can join Fairy Mary, Bobble and Clank, Rosetta, Iridessa and all the other fairies as they teach Tink about Pixie Dust, sprinting thistles, the many uses of acorns, and the magical world of Pixie Hollow. Each episode of this puzzle based adventure features mini stories from the world of Pixie Hollow and is a part of an even larger tale.

title: Kisha de GO!
description:
Kisha de Go! is an offshoot of the Densha de Go! series. This version of the game allows players to drive a steam train, rather than an electric train like the other entries.
The coverage included portions of the Keihin-Tōhoku Line, Shin'etsu Main Line and Ban'etsu-Sai Line. The controls were made slightly more complex to reflect steam operation.

title: The White Birch
description: The White Birch is a PC prototype developed by Double Fine during their 2012 Amnesia Fortnight.

title: Black Lake
description: Black Lake is a first-person survival horror game set in an abandoned orphanage beside an endless black ocean. Search for your missing sister, survive what the children became, and uncover the ritual beneath the lake.

title: The Button Affair
description: An auto-runner revolving around a thief as he attempts a heist to nab the priceless Button Jewel

title: Autonomous
description: Autonomous is a game for the Leap Motion controller from Double Fine Productions.

title: Otherworld: Spring of Shadows
description: PC

title: Otherworld: Omens of Summer
description: PC

title: 9: The Dark Side of Notre Dame
Azada: in Libro
description: Save the three worlds contained inside of a magical book in Azada: In Libro! After being approached by a notary and being informed of an inheritance, you travel off to Prague and find the magical book. One of Azada’s guardians, Titus, informs you that you have been chosen to save the different worlds, so you’re off on an incredible adventure! Stop an evil magician from conquering Azada and protect the guardians in this incredible Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure game!

title: Shady's Poopong
description: Pong! But with poop! And a toilet! And a... gorilla's head....

title: Crosscountry USA
description: A cross country driving game for the PC.

title: OSP Entertainment Complete Archive
description: A CD or digital download collecting all OSP Entertainment games released, as well as some bonus goodies.

title: Dusty Raging Fist
description: Side-scrolling 2D hand-drawn brawler inspired by Double Dragon, Streets of Rage and Devil May Cry.

title: London-Faversham High Speed
description: London-Faversham High Speed brings together the exhilaration of high speed trains with the more serene ‘classic’ third rail lines of Kent all in one route, complete with the streamlined Southeastern Class 395.

title: I, Cyborg
description: The player controls a wrongly-imprisoned cyborg that must destroy or avoid various enemy types throughout several different levels. All levels also include an end boss that must be destroyed with a special weapon.

title: Stay Out
description:
Stay Out, also known as Stalker Online, is a MMOTPS inspired by the S.T.A.L.K.E.R series of games and the novel "Roadside Picnic."

Discover a world full of dangers and incredible events, which has its own laws and principles.

Become one of the “Stalkers” - people living the romance of the unknown, able to overcome any trials in search of artifacts on the territory of the Alienation Zone.
Take a look beyond the edge of the unknown, where the secrets of nature and deadly dangers await the daredevils at every turn.
Survive in harsh conditions, when you count every sip of water and every match.
Secret laboratories, life forms of unknown origin, mysterious anomalies, and strange artifacts that challenge our knowledge of the laws of nature - all this is a huge world of "Stay Out".

title: Daffy Duck, P.I.: The Case of the Missing Letters
description: Daffy Duck, PI - The Case Of Missing Letters is a Puzzle game, developed by RSP and published by Psygnosis, which was released in 1991 for the PC.

title: Chimeras: Tune of Revenge
description: Chimeras: Tune of Revenge is a hidden objects game.

title: Sail Simulator 5
description: The most simulated of sailing, for the fifth time.

title: Kajiri Kamui Kagura
description:
In ancient Ashihara no Nakatsukuni, generals fought each other to gain the favour of the emperor. They attempted to invade the uncharted eastern lands, but suffered total defeat at the hands of demons more intelligent than humans. Three hundred years later, the land of the gods, Shinshuu, has locked itself away from all foreign countries, but an air of gloom begins to drift in from the east. They are forced to head east again to drive away the demons.

This is the all ages version of Kajiri Kamui Kagura, adding 5 new chapters including a prequel and after story, several new CGs, a new opening, and quality of life features.

title: Wizardry Empire: Princess of the Ancient
description: Wizardry Empire - Princess of the Ancient (aka Wizardry Empire - Inishie no Oujou) is the first game in the Empire series for Playstation game consoles, a sequel was also released in Playstation one and the third game in the series was released for the PSP console.

title: Type da Puyo Puyo
description: Type da Puyo Puyo is a typing game featuring characters from the Puyo Puyo series.

title: Twilight Refrain
description: A bullet-hell shooter from Aqloopand the sequel to Twilight Insanity. It is notable for non-linear branching routes, where character choices, character behaviour, dialogue choices and player skills impact the levels played, boss battles, plot progression, and endings obtained.

title: Alien Disco Safari
description: Point-and-shoot PC game where aliens invade earth to take our disco.

title: Monsters Love Candy
description: A puzzle game from Other Ocean Interactive

title: Labyrinth of Touhou
description: Touhou no Meikyuu, also known as Touhou Labyrinth, is a fan-made Touhou Project-centric dungeon crawler with similarities to titles such as Wizardry or Etrian Odyssey. A large cast of Touhou characters are included, as well as a number of references and cameos of other role-playing, anime, and danmaku titles. A sequel, Labyrinth of Touhou 2 was released at Comiket 84.

title: Lost Saga
description: Lost Saga is an action brawler filled with your favourite heroes from myths, legends, fantasies, sci-fi and more! Create your own hero squad and team up with your buddies in a time-lost war!

title: Otoko Dogeza Zigoku
description: Otoko Dogeza Zigoku is a very short, thoroughly nonsensical, and superbly manly visual novel. No matter what happens, do NOT genuflect.

title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Horns of the Reach
description:
A DLC pack for Elder Scrolls Online that is free for those with an active ESO Plus subscription or available for purchase costing 1500 Crowns, about $16(US) worth of the games premium currency.

It contains 2 new dungeons as well as new gear, unique item sets, boss collectibles, titles, and achievements.

"The Horns of the Reach DLC game pack arrives with Bloodroot Forge and Falkreath Hold, two brand new, challenging dungeons for four-player groups that pit you and your party against the menacing hordes of the Dreadhorn Clan."

title: Arctic Combat
description: Arctic Combat is a Free-to-play online first-person shooter featuring a realistic gameplay experience powered by the Unreal Engine. Arctic Combat revolves around the story of a national conflict between two groups; the Allied Forces (AF) – led by the United States, and the Red Star Alliance (RSA) – led by Russia. What begins as a dispute over natural resources in the arctic leads to a violent clash between the AF and RSA, dividing the world into two opposing forces and marking the beginning of World War III.

title: Great Adventures: Pirate Ship
description: An educational video game based off Fisher-Price's Pirates toy line.

title: Roam
description: ROAM is a silly sandbox game where you play as a wild horse! Customize your horse and five members of your herd and explore the open world! Reunite and take care of your herd! Breed your horses to welcome new foals! Choose to cause havoc in the local towns! However you play, roam free!

title: Babel Deluxe
description: Test your word skills in 25 unique game types and watch your tower soar.

title: Cylinder: Puzzles Returned
description: A puzzle game developed by Mighty Rabbit Studios.

title: Cosmic Osmo's Hex Isle
description: Cyan World's sequel to Cosmic Osmo and the Worlds Beyond the Mackerel.

title: Gunstringer: Dead Man Running
description: New Gunstringer game exclusive to Windows 8 / RT.

title: Cat Planet
description: A 2D platformer featuring an angel that must explore a planet full of cats.

title: EZ2ON
description: EZ2ON is an online music game based on the arcade game called "EZ2DJ."

title: Boulder Dash: Treasure Pleasure
description: Boulder Dash game for Windows and mobile phones.

title: Dispel
description: Dispel is the third-person, action RPG that features permanent death and procedurally generated levels. Adventure solo in this challenging roguelike-inspired game.

title: Airport Mania 2: Wild Trips
description: The sequel to Airport Mania: First Flights

title: Crown of Glory: Europe in the Age of Napoleon
description: A real-time strategy game that takes place two centuries after the beginning of the Napoleonic wars.

title: Tsukihime
description:
This story is about a young boy named Tohno Shiki who, after experiencing a traumatic accident, wakes up in the hospital with the ability to see lines and cracks in every surface and being. These lines, when traced with any sharp or blunt edge, will be permanently cut. As he is forced to see these lines everywhere, Shiki is distraught until he meets a mage girl who gives him glasses that allow him to live a normal life.

Years later, after living in a relative's home, the death of his father has him summoned back to the mansion he left years ago. There he must learn to live with his younger sister and two maid girls.

One day Shiki's life takes a turn for the worst when, on the way to school, he meets a blonde woman and he's overcome with the urge to kill her.

title: Kao the Kangaroo: Mystery of the Volcano
description: Kao the Kangaroo: Mystery of the Volcano is a third instalment of the epic Kao the Kangaroo 3D platformer series where the player takes control of a brave Kao, who embarks on a journey to save his homeland from an erupting volcano. Help him succeed!

title: X-Plane 7
description: A flight simulation game released in 2003.

title: iFishing
description: iFishing is a mobile fishing simulator by Rocking Pocket Games. It was originally developed and released on iOS and Android, and is now released on the PSN Store for the Playstation Vita.

title: Dr. Brain: Action Reaction
description: This is the final Dr. Brain game, released by Knowledge Adventure in 1999. Using the three laws of physics, Dr. Brain must escape the underwater base and stop the bad guy.

title: Pokémon: Masters Arena
description: A collection of eight Pokémon-related minigames, released for the PC in 2004. When all minigames are completed, eight Pokémon posters are unlocked for printing.

title: Pokémon Team Turbo
description:
Pokémon: Team Turbo is a game compilation intended for young children, themed after the Pokémon franchise.

The game contains six races and five mini-games such as Bulbasaur's Domino Dash and Squirtle's Door Dilemma, which upon winning, gives the player special powers to use in the races. The controls are very simple: the mouse is used to steer and the mouse buttons are used to activate the powers.

title: Mobiloid
description: A physics-based puzzle game for Windows about a freely-customizable controllable robot in an automated factory, with Metroid-like upgrades and level design.

title: Saddle Up: Time to Ride
description: Horse racing and horse caring game.

title: Pippa Funnell: The Stud Farm Inheritance
description: Alexandra Ledermann (in France) and Pippa Funnell (in the UK) is a horse themed video gaming series by Lexis Numérique.

title: Riding Champion: Legacy of Rosemond Hill
description: You play as Annie, who has inherited a horse that is stabled at Rosemond Hill, and your goal is to win the prestigious Kingswood Championship. To achieve that goal you have to care for your horse, like feeding and cleaning it, and train it in show jumping, endurance riding and cross country riding, to get in top shape for several championships along the way. Explore the horse farm to engage with Annie’s friends and discover the secrets of Rosemond Hill.

title: Zineth
description: A movement based adventure game released in 2012 by Arcane Kids. Features unique integration of Twitter through an in-game smartphone.

title: The 4th Wall
description: What lies beyond The 4th Wall?

title: Namiko
description: A PSX-inspired psychological horror game about ritual, memory, and survival. Awaken inside a haunted bathhouse, confront lingering spirits, and uncover the truth behind a corrupted village.

title: 4 Elements II
description: Set the fairies free and restore the book of magic. This is a fantasy-themed match 3 game with many levels and mini games.

title: Zilm: a game of reflex
description: Zilm is the new PC and iPad game that tests the player's reflexes.

title: Kaijuland Battles
description: Kaijuland Battles brings the monsters of Kaijuland to a versus fighting scenario.

title: Murder on the Titanic
description: A page for Murder on the Titanic by Easy Interactive.

title: I'm Gonna Be God of The Forest
description: An ecology simulator with RTS elements where the player must raise an army of beasts to defend the forest from invading machines.

title: CSPromod
description: A recreation of Counter-Strike 1.6 gameplay in a more moddable Counter-Strike: Source, created specifically for eSports.

title: Dirty Split
description: When a plastic surgeon is found murdered in his office the police are quick to apprehend a prime suspect. It is a textbook case – except the suspect didn't do it. There is more to the deceased doctor than meets the eye. Much more.

title: Disaster Response Unit
description: A simulator game published by rondomedia.

title: Phenomeno: Mitsurugi Yoishi wa Kowagaranai
description: Visual novel adapted from the youth horror novel written by Hajime Ninomae and illustrated by Yoshitoshi ABe.

title: AlphaJax
description: AlphaJax is a word based board game, much like Scrabble and Words With Friends that is exclusive to the Windows Phone platform.

title: Alex Builds His Farm
description:
Alex Builds His Farm is a game based on the world of the Playmobil franchise where the boy Alex wants to become a farmer. In a 3D world, he can participate in different activities such as constructing a farm by copying the shapes and colours of a model, scare away the crows in a wheat labyrinth, help Mrs. Duck find her ducklings on the lake, race his dog Oscar, collect eggs in the henhouse, and more. Each building holds different activities and Alex can also walk around to talk to other characters such as his parents, grandparents, Oscar the dog and his sister Sarah.

Alex can win up to three certificates (ranging from Good Farmer to The Best Farmer) and print these afterwards. He also carries The Big Farming Book that tracks the progress of the different activities and offers additional information.

title: Hokuto no Ken Online
description: A MMORPG game that was in the works that was hosted by GungHo Online Entertainment

title: WWE With Authority!
description: WWE with Authority! is a discontinued online card game featuring the WWE license.

title: Hyakuretsuken: Hokuto no Ken Gekiuchi 3
description: This is the 4th Hokuto No Ken typing game released.

title: The Fool and his Money
description: This meta-puzzle game continues the story of The Fool's Errand. It was released on October 25, 2012 for Mac and PC.

title: Genetos
description: Genetos is a Japanese freeware game by Tatsuya Koyama that explores the history of the Shoot-em-up genre through play.

title: Typing Shuugyou: Hokuto no Ken Gekiuchi Zero
description: This was the third typing game from the Hokuto No Ken series.

title: Typing Haou: Hokuto no Ken Gekiuchi 2
description: This is a typing game that is a sequel to the first typing game.

title: Vectorgeddon
description: Vectorgeddon is a Missile-Command-styled game where you must defend the Earth from asteroids.

title: GranAge Online
description: 2d-anime themed side scrolling MMO.

title: Typing Ougi: Hokuto no Ken Gekiuchi
description: This is a typing game from the Hokuto No Ken series where typing words kills the enemies.

title: Atomega
description: Grow, fight, collect and evade in the last cosmic arena the very end of time. Acquire Mass to evolve your Exoform from the nimble Atomto the godlike Omega and compete for fun and dominance in a fast-paced, multiplayer shooter.

title: Robonauts
description:
Jump between planets, fight weird creatures, and save the galaxy alone or with a friend.

Robonauts combines familiar arcade shooting gameplay with a unique possibility to switch gravity. Colorful graphics appeal to both younger and adult players while first-class music by Simon Viklund makes the adventure feel even more epic.

title: Soudentou no Mimei
description: A visual novel about a lone maiden and a human shaped demon exterminating evil monsters.

title: Ultraman: The Ultimate Fighting
description: Low budget PC fighting game.

title: Top Trumps: Dogs & Dinosaurs
description: A Top Trumps card game featuring the Dogs & Dinosaurs deck.

title: Rockett's Camp Adventures
description: The sixth and final game in the Rockett Movado series of visual novels.

title: Rockett's First Dance
description: The fourth game in the Rockett Movado series of visual novels.

title: Rockett's Adventure Maker
description: The fifth game in the Rockett Movado series. Unlike its predecessors, it allowed players to create their own characters and scenes with a rudimentary scripting interface.

title: Rockett's Secret Invitation
description: The third game in the Rockett Movado series of visual novels.

title: Rockett's Tricky Decision
description: The second game in the Rockett Movado series of visual novels.

title: Dungeon Travelers: To Heart 2 in Another World
description: The dungeon is dangerous and deep, but with the right party, you can conquer every nook and cranny. Find loot, equip your party, and customize your classes to master the turn-based RPG combat in this old-school dungeon crawler!

title: District 187: Sin Streets
description: Gangsters and cops collide in this free-to-play first-person shooter.

title: Eraser: Turnabout
description: Eraser Turnabout is a predominantly action game with some puzzle-solving, featuring pre-rendered action scenes and a lot of recorded full screen video. You play the role of John Krueger on a hectic mission to shut down a conspiracy in a few hours that threatens the free world and to stop a terrorist strike. Along the way you get to shoot a lot of assassins, solve puzzles and clues. There are a few additional characters that accompany you on the way, but mostly you will be on your own.

title: The X-Files: Unrestricted Access
description: As an extension of one of the most long-running television series of all time, The X-Files, play through the eyes of Special Agent Craig Willmore, a new FBI field investigator brought in to locate missing agents Fox Mulder and Dana Scully whose last location was the Everett, Washington, area. In this "movie quality" video production, characters are played by the actors and actresses from the show, including Gillian Anderson (Scully) and David Duchovny (Mulder).

title: Big Air Wakeboarding
description:
Big Air Wakeboarding is probably the first wakeboarding game for PC :) But WTF is wakeboarding? :) Well, wakeboarding is the watersport of the 1990's, and the fastest-growing board sport world-wide. Akin to snowboarding, the sports popularity is spreading like wildfire around the globe. Evolving from a combination of waterskiing, snowboarding, skating and surfing, wakeboarding is not only the world's fastest-growing water board sport but also the most accessible. It can be done on waterski lakes or on the sea. Riders are able to perform amazing BIG AIR tricks (Backwash, Bindings, Edge, Fakie etc), whilst being towed behind a boat, with the use of big boards and big wakes. The rider stands sideways on a shorter, wider board similar in concept to a snowboard. If you have no imagination, look at these shots from real wakeboarding (shot1, shot2, shot3). So now I think you have an idea kind of sport wakeboarding is, so back to the game. 
Big Air Wakeboarding features over eight distinct characters, hundreds of different mind-bending trick combos, multiple jumps and obstacles, real wakeboards from O'Brien, and Darin Shapiro - the 2000 X Games and Pro Wakeboard Tour Champion. In the game you can choose from Career, Competition and Quick Start. In Career mode you have to collect Gas cans, to improve your character over time.These Gas cans unlock new board graphics and improve on the quality of all boards. Gas can also unlock better boats with bigger wakes and more advanced tie-ins. In Competition you got three runs out in the open water to try and rack up the most points - any medal in a competition will unlock the next course. If you like skateboarding and snowboarding games, maybe this game could be quite interesting for you.

title: Jottobots
description: Jottobots is a bite sized action adventure platformer with a world to explore and some power ups to collect. Take control of one of the last surviving Jottobots as he searches for the ray of hope that will save him from the hostile world he has found himself stranded upon.

title: Brazen
description: Brazen is a fast-paced first-person elemental roguelite wield volatile magic, chain destructive reactions, and zoom through surreal arenas with high-mobility spell combat.

title: Edelweiss Eiden Fantasia
description:
On a desert island in the south there lies an all-girls school where students learn the mysterious art of alchemy. This strange academy, known as Eiden Academy, is the setting of Edelweiss, a tale of laughs and tears shared between the heroines, who lived their lives free of men on this island, and Haruma Kazushi, one of the silly boys who came here to score. This is an all-new game which picks up where Edelweiss ended.

The heroines of this new story are Takase Sakura and Fujisaki Rin, two background characters who dominated the popularity polls and conquered the original heroines. This fan-disk will present an all-new story full of laughs and naughty things.

One scenario begins when Sakura, the girl many people suspect is a lesbian, is hanging with the guys and evaluating other chicks with them. When Kazushi says there’s no way he would ever fall for Sakura, Sakura puts her pride as a girl on the line and their competition begins. If he falls for her, he loses! As their classmates start a betting pool to see who’ll win and interfering to better their chances, who knows what ending awaits, let alone how Eiden Island’s power will affect the outcome!

The other scenario begins when Rin and Kazushi are both elected as their class representatives. As the two grow closer together, Kazushi winds up in an accident trying to save her. As a result, he suddenly finds himself with something that speaks residing in his crotch.

title: Operation 7
description: A fast paced modern military themed online FPS.

title: Argo Online
description: A combined steampunk and fantasy themed 3D MMORPG that focuses battlegrounds and duels.

title: 100 Years War Online
description: A 3D MMORPG fantasy game that was developed using Unreal Engine.

title: Extreme Road Trip 2
description: Extreme Road Trip 2 is a mobile side-scrolling racing game where the objective is to travel as far as possible on a limited supply of fuel by picking up power-ups and doing stunts to increase your speed temporarily. In-game micro-transactions allow you to buy more power-ups, although they are also obtainable by leveling up your driver or finishing vehicle-specific missions.

title: Sleepwalker's Journey
description: A puzzle platformer where you must help the sleepwalking Moonboy reach his bed.

title: Times of Conflict
description: Times of Conflict is a Sci-Fi RTS game developed by Eugen Systems.

title: Funky Smugglers
description: iOS action game based around airport security, featuring a comical aspect and a 70's soundtrack.

title: Louisiana Adventure
description: An adventure game by SilverPlay.

title: Aaron Crane: Paintings Come Alive
description: An adventure game developed by Match Gems. Aaron’s father Dominic paints spooky images from his subconscious and no one seems to know what they mean. Suddenly, Dominic disappears and it’s up to his son to track him down.

title: FIFA Online 2
description: FIFA Online is a series of online sports games developed by Electronic Arts (EA). Based on EA's FIFA series of games, it is released with a free-to-play model with a focus on the Asian video game market.

title: David Bellamy's Endangered Wildlife
description: Stop endangered species from being wiped out in this educational PC game.

title: Irisu Syndrome
description: Irisu Syndrome is a freeware physics puzzle game created by Japanese developer wtatsu, about a group of friends on a summer camping trip that takes a dark turn when one of them goes missing. The gameplay involves shapes of various colors falling down in a tetris-like play field. It has garnered a small, cult following due in part to it's unconventional story.

title: Qasir Al-Wasat: A Night in-Between
description: Qasir Al-Wasat: A Night in-Between tells the story of an invisible and frail creature which is summoned on 12th century Syria for a mission of infiltration and assassination, where it investigates and discovers the secrets of a wondrous palace and a trap that was set for it. The game employs simple mechanics and conceptual sounds and visuals.

title: Exo-Planet
description: A third-person shooter, with anti-gravity elements. Developed for iPhone/iPod Touch by SGN.

title: Bust a Move Online
description: PC version of Bust-A-Move with online support.

title: F/A-18 Operation Iraqi Freedom
description:
F/A-18 Operation Iraqi Freedom or Operation Desert Storm is the successor to F/A-18 Hornet Korea. It features a campaign with 27 unrelated missions set in the Gulf region. Typical examples are the bombing of ground targets or escort missions. On most missions the player gets help by other aircraft including the famous A-10 Warthog.

The game strongly focuses on the realistic simulation of the F/A-18 Hornet so the player has to work with a complex set of key combinations to control it. Twelve tutorial missions are designed to introduce the player step by step to the aircraft. The game also features an editor to create custom missions.

title: Absolute Force Online
description: Absolute Force Online is a first-person shooting game, which is the first in China to make use of the Unreal 3 Engine. Players can take on the roles of hardened mercenaries, either the fiendish Rotten Angels or the honorable Hands of Justice. They are able to use advanced weapons and military vehicles (aircraft and tanks) to fight battles in famous locations, mysterious islands, and modern cities from all around the world. There will also be campaign modes featured, where you can fight alongside your teammates against infected zombies and other dangerous enemies.

title: Anonymous Agony
description: Anonymous Agony follows the parallel stories of a child psychologist named James Samson, and a rising serial killer named Haze Stratos.

title: Modern War: Somalian Pirates
description: The player escorts a variety of civilian ships by either helicopter or by boat. The one and only objective is to use a Gatling gun to destroy small boats filled with Somali pirates armed with automatic rifles and RPG launchers.

title: Sonic PC Collection
description: An Australia/New Zealand-exclusive PC multi-pack with several Sonic games.

title: Bomberman Collection Vol. 2
description: A Japan-only follow-up to the previous PC collection.

title: Bomberman Collection
description: Three classic Bomberman games on one disc.

title: Dazzeloids
description:
Dazzeloids is a 1994 children's CD-ROM game created by Rodney Greenblat, who also made PaRappa the Rapper.

It features Anne Dilly Whim, and her team of boredom banishers fighting the forces of mediocrity set by the Mediogre and his geeky assistant, Pin Bleeper.

title: Goblet Grotto
description: Goblet Grotto is a freeware, surrealist dungeon crawler by the creator of Space Funeral and the artist behind the webcomic Monster Killers. Players must guide a toad warrior through the titular grotto in search of goblets while also maintaining the toad's depression.

title: Hero-U: Rogue to Redemption
description: An hybrid role-playing game from the designers of Quest for Glory. This new hybridization is based around incorporating the iconic elements of King's Quest and Quest for Glory in a new, immersive format.

title: Deer Hunter Reloaded
description:
Deer Hunter is Back!
Deer Hunter: Reloaded is a 1st person hunting simulation game based off of the #1 hunting franchise in the World. Deer Hunter will provide an authentic hunting experience for players as they venture to some of the top-rated hunting regions in North America from the plains of West Texas to the rugged terrain of Alaska.

title: Out of the Park Baseball 13
description: The latest iteration of the long-running PC baseball management sim, produced by Out of the Park Developments. The most highly customizable baseball game of its kind on the market, OOTP allows the player to control all aspects of a franchise from the front office downward to try and build a champion.

title: WGT Golf
description: Experience iconic golf courses like Pebble Beach, St Andrews and Wolf Creek in the most realistic free golf game, now available on PC, Mac and Steam. Connect with millions of players all over the world!

title: Deer Hunter Companion
description: First expansion disc to Deer Hunter. Includes new forests, as well as a hint and tip book.

title: Pantsylvania
description: The Gigglebone Gang: Pantsylvania is an educations game. The gang visits the kingdom Pantsylvania where they teach children various facts, bits of fiction, various bouts of craziness. and can enter ten destinations, e.g. a restaurant, the castle or a school. Each location has five activities which are reached by clicking on one of the gang members or the king.

title: Iz and Auggie: Escape from Dimension Q
description: Adventures of a girl and her robot buddy.

title: Blindside
description: A fast-paced top-down shooter about prediction. Enemies are invulnerable in the light. Read their movement, fire into the dark, and trust your timing before they reach you.

title: Valhalla Chronicles
description: A game centered around vikings released in 2003.

title: Udos sagner: Sveakampen
description: Sveakampen is a Swedish action game which takes place in medieval times, released for PC in 2001. The game is based on the book Sveakampen.

title: Trains Vs Zombies 2
description: In this standalone sequel to the Halloween-themed DLC for Train Simulator 2012, New York City has been overrun by toxic slime, turning normal humans into mindless zombie-like creatures, and it is your job to rescue passengers from the Halloween nightmare that is taking over the Big Apple.

title: Centipede & Battlezone
description: Centipede & Battlezone is a mini-CD dual pack with two original coin-operated classic video games.

title: Clickomania!
description: Narrow-field SameGame with a "drop" option to play a Breakthru!-esque game.

title: BioShock Infinite: Industrial Revolution
description: A stand-alone puzzle game offered as a pre-order bonus with BioShock Infinite.

title: Starlaxis - Light Hunter
description: Command your star ships in the ACTION area by combining the right command cubes in the PUZZLE zone.

title: TMNT: Ninja Adventures
description: TMNT: Ninja Adventures is a mini game and activity center for Microsoft Windows. It was released by Focus Multimedia Ltd in May 2007. It was only sold in the UK. In the US, Ninja Adventures was packaged with TMNT action figures.

title: Capcom Arcade Hits Volume 3
description: Capcom Arcade Hits Volume 3 is a compilation of two arcade games Commando and Gun.Smoke.

title: Capcom Arcade Hits Volume 1
description: Capcom Arcade Hits Volume 1 is a compilation of two arcade games Street Fighter and Street Fighter 2.

title: Pixeline and the Jungle Treasure
description: Platformer with little Danish girl.

title: Sword of Rapier
description: Launch the enemies with combo attack! Soar high into the sky, a new style action RPG is right here!

title: Mavis Beacon Teaches Typing Version 4
description: Mavis ditches the exclamation point as she moves on to Windows 95.

title: Mavis Beacon Teaches Typing! Version 3 for Windows
description: Three! Three Mavis games! Ah ah ah

title: Mavis Beacon Teaches Typing Version 12
description: Mavis learns Spanish!

title: Mavis Beacon Keyboarding Kidz
description: Mavis Beacon teaches kids to type... again.

title: Dream Pinball 3D II
description:
The cancelled sequel to Dream Pinball 3D targeting the next generation of hardware of the original.

As well as new tables, it was going to introduce a clever slow-motion function that enables the player to master that particularly difficult skill shot and features a full list of varied mini-games that can be unlocked in single player experience. Thus, adding an element of progression and immersion that is unrivalled in high score games!

title: Bust-N-Rush
description: A 3D runner, the game has the player run through destructible objects while dodging indestructible objects and jumping pits.

title: ALF's Party Kit!
description: Make party supplies with ol' ALFer!

title: Reckless Racing Ultimate
description: Top down racing for Windows 8

title: Fantasy Tennis
description: Fantasy Tennis is a tennis game in which the players create a character like in an online role-playing game and improve their skills by leveling up the property values ​​strength (STR), endurance (STA), dexterity (DEX) and cleverness (Wil). As an opponent you have primarily human players in order to be able to measure yourself against them. Several players can form tennis clubs ( guilds ) for which a battle function ( raid) is being planned. In addition, the property values ​​can be increased by using special items of clothing, each with extra capabilities. These are available in the item shop and can be paid for using either the cash currency alaplaya Points (AP) or the in-game currency gold. Popular items included the speaker, which the game falsely described as an improved version of itself, the Wing of Memory, for which the player spent AP every month to reset their stats, or the so-called gachas, a more expensive variant, to to get to QS. The game itself takes place in the parallel world FantasyLand and takes place on different courts wie Nest Of Rubycrab, Twinkle Town, Snow Moon, Life Woods, Emerald Beach, Arena, Deva Berg oder Atlantis statt.

title: Mystery Trackers: The Void
description: After three world famous celebrities go missing inside the Void family mansion, it’s up to the Mystery Trackers to solve its mysteries once and for all.

title: Polda 5
description: Fifth game of the series Awesome Cop.

title: Kingdoms & Lords
description: Kingdoms & Lords is a medieval strategy and simulation game.

title: Polda 4
description: It is a fourth entry in the Polda series about a dumb detective named Pankrác and his adventures. It's a humorous point and click adventure. Polda 4 is the first Polda game rendered completely in 3D graphics.

title: Halo Zero
description: A fan-made freeware sidescrolling shooter based on the Halo series, featuring both single-player and multiplayer modes

title: Strange Cases: the Secrets of Grey Mist Lake
description: Strange Cases: the Secrets of Grey Mist Lake is another entry in the Strange Cases series.

title: Splash Fighters
description: GetAmped is a free-to-play MMO Fighting-Action game developed and published by the Japanese company CyberStep, Inc. Initially mainly published in Asia and in North America (under the name Splash Fighters), it has more recently also been released in Brazil and in Europe, including Germany and France. As of 12 November 2012, GetAmped has officially been released and is being played in 16 different countries, and the number of registered users playing GetAmped all over the world exceeds 26 million (as of April 2009). With these latest releases, CyberStep has begun to put into practice its goal of releasing GetAmped in English, German, French, Russian, Turkish and Portuguese in the near future. GetAmped was published by Lyto in Indonesia on 2005 before CyberStep expanded to Indonesia and take over the license on 2013.

title: Cypher: Cyberpunk Text Adventure
description:
Cyberpunk interactive fiction video game written by the Cabrera Brothers and released on August 31, 2012. It updates the traditional text adventure format by including music, sound effects and limited graphical elements to the game. The game is available as a download for Microsoft Windows and Macintosh OS X, purchasable directly from the creators' website.
Gameplay consists of the player reading descriptions of their character's location and surroundings as presented in text form by the game, then inputting their desired actions into the text parser. Further atmospheric detail is provided throughout the game in the form of background music and sound effects, as well as an animated image of the player character on the righthand side of the screen. When the player collects an important object from the game environment, these too are displayed on the right hand side. These images are updated when the object changes, such as when a dirty keycard is cleaned or a device is activated.

title: Strange Cases: The Tarot Card Mystery
description: Strange Cases: The Tarot Card Mystery is a hidden objects game.

title: Strange Cases: The Lighthouse Mystery
description: Strange Cases: The Lighthouse Mystery is a hidden objects game from Sulus Games.

title: Sevencore
description: Sevencore is a free MMORPG with a focus on Mount based combat.

title: Curse of the Ghost Ship
description: A woman is sailing on a boat with her crew when it gets hit by an old ship named the Pride. When she wakes up she finds herself on board the Pride, and while trying to leave she meets a ghost which seems to play a bigger role than she first thinks.

title: EverQuest: Rain of Fear
description: EverQuest: Rain of Fear is the nineteenth expansion to the original EverQuest.

title: Echoes of the Past: The Citadels of Time
description: Echoes of the Past: The Citadels of Time is a hidden object game.

title: Echoes of the Past: Royal House of Stone
description: Echoes of the Past: Royal House of Stone is a hidden objects game.

title: Echoes of the Past: The Revenge of the Witch
description: Echoes of the Past: The Revenge of the Witch is a hidden object game for the PC and Mac.

title: Hinokakera the Fragments of Innocent Sinner
description: A doujin fighting game featuring 2D fighter mechanics in a 3D plane.

title: Polda 2
description: A direct sequel to 1998's Polda about a not-that-smart policeman called Pankrác. It's a point and click adventure based on puzzles and crazy humor.

title: Polda 3
description: A third sequel in the Polda series about of a former cop known by the name of Pankrác who is now a private detective. It's an point and click adventure focused on absurd scenes, situational humor and irony.

title: Michinoku Hisen Koimonogatari
description: A dating themed adventure game by F.O.G.

title: Clover no Kuni no Alice: Wonderful Wonder World
description: Clover no Kuni no Alice: Wonderful Wonder World is the second installment in the Heart no Kuni no Alice series and the direct sequel to Heart no Kuni no Alice. It was originally released in December 2007 for PC and later released for the PS2 and PSP.

title: Pac-Guy
description: Less of a Pac-Man clone and more of a parody. Also lampoons popular science fiction films.

title: Arbiter
description: Arbiter is an action game about transformation. You control Ashe, the new Arbiter, whose job is to hunt down the demonic Ether and Umbra spirits that threaten humanity. Being the opposite type of your enemy will allow you to hurt them, while being the same type will make you immune to their attacks. The game's fast-paced combat and challenging enemies force you to master the art of transformation in order to succeed.

title: Xenocite Clad
description: Xenocite Clad places you in the long forgotten ruins of an advanced civilization that seemed to disappear overnight. Now, centuries later, the ruins have filled with life, both threatening and non. Brave the ruins against predators and more as you search for not only a way out, but the answers to the questions strewn all around you. Play as two heroines- Xalia the syr, using both an energy blade and an energy compressor drone, she seeks to learn more of her creators and their intentions this path will make her face the sins of her fathers and right them. ...and well you don't need to know about the other one yet do you?

title: Alice's Tea Cup Madness
description: Time management game.

title: A Dwarf's Story
description: Mixture of hidden object and arcade game.

title: Enchanted Katya and the Mystery of the Lost Wizard
description: Time management game. Help Katya, a student of the highest magic mastery school, manage a magic shop and locate its missing owner - the wizard Took. Choose ingredients, brew potions, and locate mysterious artifacts that reveal the wizard's location.

title: Starbeast
description: A 2.5D sidescrolling shooter for Wii U, PC and mobile platforms

title: Women's Murder Club: Twice in a Blue Moon
description: Adventure/Hidden object game.

title: Go-Go Gourmet
description: Time management game.

title: Dr. Lynch: Grave Secrets
description: Hidden object game.

title: Nocturnal: Boston Nightfall
description: Play as the recently deceased Claire as she uncovers the secrets of her immortal powers in this mysterious hidden object game. Solve all the clever puzzles that come your way. Quickly find hidden secret items to increase your supernatural abilities. The night challenges you, will you rise to the challenge? Step into the darkness with Nocturnal: Boston Nightfall!

title: Hidden Expedition: The Uncharted Islands
description: Hidden Expedition: The Uncharted Islands is a hidden object game and the fifth entry into the Hidden Expedition series of "seek and find" games. The gameplay is similar to previous instalments, with the focus being on finding items scattered across a diverse collection of scenes. Some items are placed in the player's inventory and need to be used in other locations to advance in the game. The game does feature some variations on the basic hidden object formula, with many hidden object scenes being two screens wide, and some items only being revealed by the manipulation of other items.

title: Sanatorium
description: Escape the Sanatorium and face your fears. After escaping your room, you find out that the sanatorium isn’t just for helping people with mental illnesses.. but for something way, way worse… After all of it.. was it all just a dream?

title: Hidden Expedition: Devil's Triangle
description:
Hidden Expedition: Devil's Triangle is the fourth entry in the hidden object game series produced by Big Fish Games since 2006. As in most recent titles of the genre, the adventure elements are more pronounced with full inventory and puzzles complementing the simple hidden object scenes.

Like in most first-person point-and-click adventures, the player navigates through various locations by clicking on hotspots positioned over obvious exit openings, like doors and other places. The rooms are presented as a series of static screens with interactive portions. The cursor is context-sensitive, changing shape when hovering over an interactive part of the scenery. It morphs into an eye when over a place with a close-up view, that sometimes contains a hidden object scene or a mini-game. It transforms into golden arrows when over one of the exit hotspots. It becomes a hand when over a scenery object that can be collected. It displays swirling blue circles over special areas where an inventory item can be used.

title: Cassandra's Journey: The Legacy of Nostradamus
description: Cassandra's Journey: The Legacy of Nostradamus is a hidden object game that puts you in the role of Cassandra, a young mystic relying on a mysterious ring to solve cases that are assumed to be impossible. The game features animated cutscenes, mind-reading magic tricks, and fun for the whole family.

title: Mystery Chronicles: Murder Among Friends
description:
Murder and mistrust abound in the town of Lyon in the year 1899.

Trail an elusive killer through the back-roads of France, and solve clever puzzles to halt the terror. Comb locations like libraries, museums, graveyards, and sewers for hidden objects and clues. Test your deduction skills and don't be fooled by false sincerity.

title: Treasure Seekers: Visions of Gold
description: Treasure Seekers: Visions of Gold is a hidden object game released for PC and mobile platforms. It is the first installment of the Treasure Seeker series.

title: Master of Defense
description: 3D tower defense strategy game.

title: Alice Greenfingers 2
description: Sequel to Alice Greenfingers.

title: Azada: Ancient Magic
description: Point-and click adventure and sequel to Azada.

title: IHF Handball Challenge 13
description: The follow-up to IHF Handball Challenge 12. It was quietly canceled so that work in IHF Handball Challenge 14 could begin.

title: Interlude
description: A keyboard rhythm game, built for fun

title: Judge Dredd: Countdown Sector 106
description: A text adventure/dice rolling game on the iPad and iPhone, and is a game/book hybrid.

title: Voxelstein 3D
description: A free small voxel-based game which is still in development and is loosely inspired by Wolfenstein 3D. Uses Ken Silverman's VOXLAP engine.

title: DataJack
description: DataJack is a 2D isometric stealth action shooter originally released in 2013. In the not-too-distant future, governments have dissolved and powerful mega-corporations wage covert wars for territory and the control of information. As a freelance mercenary, you will conduct sabotage, assassinations, espionage and ambushes on their behalf to earn a living.

title: Stone Smash
description: Stone Smash is a freeware Breakout clone released for Windows PCs in 2005. Ports to other platforms would start releasing in 2013.

title: Memories Off #5 Encore
description: Encore takes place in December, about six months after the summer season events that took place in Memories Off #5: Togireta Film. A festival competition for creating a short movie is going to be held on February, next year, which will give plenty of time for the same protagonist, Haruto Kawai, to both make the movie and meet new girls. In this fan disk sequel, the story focuses only on three different girls: Asuka Hina, Mahiro Sendou, and Akina Ichijou. This game also lets the player experience the story from the perspective of two other characters besides Haruto. The gameplay itself does not stray from the usual recipe of altering the story by selecting different choices that present themselves on the screen at key moment in the storyline.

title: Garfield It's All About Reading and Phonics Volume 1
description: Published by PC Treasures INC. Garfield It's All About Reading and Phonics is a educational game for the PC.

title: Memories Off: Sorekara
description: The fourth entry in the main Memories Off series of visual novels.

title: Princess Maker: Go! Go! Princess
description:
The elements of the Princess Maker series remain intact! The ability status is up through various events, training, and part-time jobs in the field! Rival, study, part-time job and love.... The tumultuous eight years will begin on the board!

Only the dice knows the destiny!
Uzu and Cube The navigator to help your daughter. Throw a dice and go on an adventure with the friend who will decide your daughter's fate!

title: Urban Rivals World
description: Roll up your sleeves and lay down your cards! Urban Rival is a truly original, free, collectible card game. It is a game of skill and strategy that allows you to create your own gang and challenge other players in fast and furious fighting. The games are simple but intense and in just a few minutes you can control the whole of Clint City by putting your Pillz, Fury and bluffing skills to good use!

title: Australia Zoo Quest: Puzzle Fun!
description: Puzzle solving game.

title: Combat Mission: Fortress Italy
description: Turn-based/real-time tactical strategy game that simulates battles fought in Italy during WW2.

title: Higurashi Daybreak Kai
description: An expansion to Higurashi Daybreak which adds new characters, weapons, and several other new features.

title: Judge Dee: The City God Case
description: A hidden object adventure set in ancient China. Take part in a rich and detailed story written by the scriptwriter of the Nancy Drew(TM) series.

title: Gravity Wars
description:
Gravity Wars Is An 90s Arcade Game.

Try to survive in the chaos of this hardcore geometric battleground, customize entirely the scenario you want with up to 12 arenas available, and see which of you or your friends can survive the longest. Nearest enemies will be attracted to you.

You will need reflexes and focus to avoid every particles displayed in the screen. Other players will try to kill you by any mean to be the last one standing.

You can entirely customize the number of entities. Set this number at your own risk.
Key Features :
* Playable Up to 4 Players Using Gamepads.
* Access to 2 superpowers : a turbo and a shockwave
*12 arenas available
* Customize entirely your game
* Amazing music made by Réno
* Full Controller Support except from the launcher to select your screen resolution and fullscreen mode.

title: City Bus
description: City Bus is an arcade game where you play the role of a crazy bus driver and distribute passengers without the traffic regulations. If you want to rampage through the city, ignoring traffic regulations and destroying everything in your way, you just found a right game for you. Delivering your passengers on time is the only thing that matters, and anything stopping you from that is your enemy. Plow at full speed through traffic jams, crash through the buildings, outrun the police patrols, level the whole city if you want to. The game features 5 buses, 5 cities, 6 lethal weapons, and 6 different types of missions.

title: Waterworld: The Quest for Dry Land
description: Real-time strategy game based on the movie Waterworld.

title: Day of the Zombie
description:
Land of the Dead was originally developed as a singleplayer PC game called Day of the Zombie, which had a four month development cycle and was ready for October 2004 release. Day of the Zombie was shown to Universal Studios around the time the movie Land of the Dead was being filmed in Toronto, Canada (where Groove is headquartered) - this is how the license was secured. The game was ported to Xbox, multiplayer functionality was added and environments were added to tie the game to the movie. But in 2009, Groove Games finally decided it was a good idea to finish Day of the Zombie and release it, even if the game has 2004 graphics.
The story, which is the only new thing compared to Land of the Dead, is about zombies who have invaded a town and 3 main characteres : a student who wants to save his girlfriend, the director of the student's college who wants to save his college from zombies, and a US army sniper who just wants to leave the town.

title: Starshatter: The Gathering Storm
description: A sequel to and remake of the original Starshatter, The Gathering Storm is a space combat game from developer Destroyer Studios.

title: SpongeBob SquarePants: Diner Dash
description: SpongeBob Diner Dash is arcade action with an undersea twist! Mr. Krabs is expanding the Krusty Krab & building an empire, and SpongeBob is the new restaurants' server. Keep him on his toes and help him earn tips, while he serves customers like slippery sturgeon, antsy anchovies, and even Bubble Bass. It's up to you and SpongeBob to seat, serve and satisfy even the squirmiest of patrons.

title: Higanbana no Saku Yoru ni: The Second Night
description: Higanbana no Saku Yoru ni: The Second Night is the second and final installment of Higanbana no Saku Yoru ni.

title: Enemy Engaged 2: Desert Operations
description: A stand-alone expansion to Enemy Engaged 2, with three new scenarios - Antarctica, Afghanistan, and Iran.

title: Craz'D
description: Craz'D is a flash game designed by Hubol Gordon in 2009. It's a story of a creature named Loon doing whatever the hell he wants because he fits his name just fine.

title: Joker no Kuni no Alice: Wonderful Wonder World
description: Joker no Kuni no Alice ~Wonderful Wonder World~ is the third installment in the Heart no Kuni no Alice series and is a side story to the first two games.

title: Super Bogus World
description: Super Bogus World is a Game Maker game made by Hubol Gordon and Oddwarg after about a year of work. It's full of strange humor, awkward scenarios, and no genre is safe from this game's mocking power.

title: Seaside Racing
description: Seaside Racing is a racing game available through the Xbox Live Indie Games service on Xbox 360.

title: Championship Manager 2009
description: Championship Manager 2009 is a cancelled soccer management game.

title: Refrain Love: Anata ni Aitai
description: A dating sim where you play as a college student who happens to live right by the campus. It's summer and you're going to America for Christmas, but you'd love to get a woman before then.Your three buddies Kousuke the jock, Tetsuya the DJ, Taizo the nerd and you vow to find a girlfriend before Christmas time. You already know some girls, so it shouldn't be a problem. But you have been having weird dreams of some mystery girl and when a walk in the park leads you to find a girl that looks suspiciously like the one of your dreams, you find that maybe you do have chance with the ladies. But, let's face it. You have to juggle part time jobs, romance, and seeing your dude friends. Welcome to Refrain Love.

title: The eXceed Collection
description: A collection of the entire eXceed shooter series: Gun Bullet Children, Vampire REX, and Jade Penetrate Black Package.

title: 3D Creation Station
description: A creative-style game where players can create their own worlds.

title: Janosik
description: Challenging retro pixel graphics action-platformer. Become a legendary rogue Janosik and explore the big mountain castle level full of secrets.

title: Shoot Many Robots: Arena Kings
description: Arena Kings is a PVP-focused shooter set in the world of Shoot Many Robots.

title: AHx-1
description: An authentic simulation of one of the world's most versatile and deadly attack helicopters, AHx-1 puts players behind the wheel of an AHx-1 Viper. The game offers 45 simulated combat missions and thirty life-like scenarios to tackle that take place in exotic enemy territory such as Columbia and Libya. Authenticity is the focus of this game designed by ex-Israeli fighter pilots to mimic actual combat.

title: Val d'Isère Ski Park Manager
description: Val d'Isère Ski Park Manager is a management game in which you are the boss of a ski resort. You start from the ground up with just some cash and are expected to open a ski resort, make some money, expand your park, perform maintenance and keep all visitors safe and happy.

title: Mary King's Riding Star
description: Riding Star is an equestrian simulation where the player has to take care of a horse and ride it in competitions. For the riding the game is shown from a top-down view and in preparation of events the horse needs to be groomed, fed and saddled. There are three different types of events to participate in: dressage, show jumping and cross country. There is also a three-day event. In the championship mode horse and rider compete in multiple championships and the player's care of the horse influences the performance. During the maintenance part everything is controlled with the mouse. In races the horse is controlled through the arrow keys with the space bar to jump. Next to the AI opponents it is also possible to compete with up to four friends on a single computer in the multiplayer event.

title: Chokotto Land
description: Online RPG for mobile and PC.

title: Trajectory of summer flower Ⅱ
description: "Wherever I am, as long as you're there, that place is my home." This is a romantic adventure game that revolves around the themes of family and rural customs. Set in the Eden touched by the summer breeze, the village journey of lavender and the colorful summer begins once again!

title: Dengeki Stryker
description:
Dengeki Stryker is a visual novel that follows Yuuki Yamato, a young boy who has a great sense of justice and aspires to be a hero.
Yamato always tried to protect his childhood friend Haruna when she was being bullied, but he always got beat down instead.
One day, Haruna was going to move away and wanted to say goodbye to him.
However, he despaired that he was never able to protect her once in the end.

title: Mutazione
description: Mutazione is a adventure exploration video game set on an island where the player tends to the local gardens and learns more about the town's people. The game takes place over different days, each with unique events. While gardening the player can grow different types of plants, from bushes to trees. Seeds can be found all over the island from other plants. The player needs to give the plant the required space in order for it to grow and different ones require other types of soil. Each plant also creates different sounds, which when combined with other greenery can create music.

title: Tribal Trouble
description: Tribal Trouble is a real-time strategy game designed with Multi-platform support Windows, Mac OS X and Linux.

title: Poker for Dummies
description: A Poker game for the PC. It features 3 game modes and teaches the player basic poker.

title: State of War 2: Arcon
description: A sequel to State of War, developed by Cypron Studios, published by Akella and Cinemax. The game was released internationally in 2007.

title: Smiles HD
description: Smiles HD is a solitaire-like and arcade matching game by Sykhronics Entertainment.

title: Antique Shop
description: Antique Shop is a hybrid time management/hidden objects game for the PC.

title: Armor Critical
description: Armor Critical is an online multiplayer player versus player game. Basically, the player controls one of 4 colors of flying saucers in capture the flag, domination, assassin, turret assassin, flip the switch, and deathmatch game modes.

title: Sacrilegium
description: A survival horror game from the creators of Two Worlds.

title: Larry's Big Score
description: Larry's Big Score is a Leisure Suit Larry-themed pinball game by Sierra.

title: Red Rogue
description: Red Rogue is a side-scrolling roguelike. Descend into the Dungeon of Chaos, retrieve the Amulet of Yendor, kill all who stand in your way and return with your prize.

title: The Naked Gun: I.C.U.P.
description: Deadpan, juvenile humor and silly one-liners rule in this episodic heir to the Naked Gun throne. Crack cases, find collectibles and annoy coworkers as Frank Drebin Jr. in this point and click adventure.

title: Renaissance Heroes
description: Renaissance Heroes was a free-to-play First Person Shooter game set in the 16th century Renaissance period.

title: Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse
description: The Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse was being developed by 3DO for the PS2, Xbox, and PC before being canceled when the company went bankrupt.

title: Drawn: Trail of Shadows
description:
Set in the years before the events of The Painted Tower and Dark Flight, Drawn: Trail of Shadows takes players on a magical journey through the distant past. Become a part of the story by following clues scattered throughout paintings to save a boy with the power to create painted worlds. Discover and confront the source of evil that seeks to possess that power...

See the world of Drawn as never before while traveling deep into each painting. Explore a fantastic garden; climb high into frozen mountain passes, and unlock the mysteries of the Ferryman’s caves on your quest to save the boy that creates the painted worlds. Who is he? What role will he play in the future of the kingdom?

The answers to these questions will be found along the trail of shadows.

title: HyperXBall
description: HyperXBall is a game of soccer. Instead of kicking the ball, you shoot it with a special gun. The arenas are the size of a soccer field but for now played indoors. The game was designed for LAN parties but can be played over the internet as well. Up to 4 players per team are allowed and the host has many options that can be selected for gameplay. Players can get damaged from the projectiles and if you disable another player you spend time in the penalty box. The ball is 10 feet in diameter and is a bit squishy. You shoot it like you would a pool ball. The game comes with 5 single player "Trials" you run for time and score. The Trials help you control the ball so you will do better in tournaments.

title: Pet Soccer
description: Pet Soccer is a soccer game featuring animals as the players. It was released on PC in 2003.

title: Pet Racer
description: Pet Racer is a cart racing game released for PC in 2003.

title: Ben Jordan: Paranormal Investigator - Case 7: The Cardinal Sins
description:
